notes.title: Dev Log for May 27th, 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to this week’s Tower Unite Dev Log!

Shortly after our last dev log, we finished up work on and released the controller support update as well as the update to the TU soundtrack! Since then we’ve been making progress on the next major update, the Workshop Rental Store, as well as various fixes for UI, Condos, and further Controller Support. There has also been progress on upcoming updates, such as Community Condos!

Workshop Rental Store / Beta
We’ve finished up work on the Workshop Rental Store and are ready to beta test it with you all this week!

Work was completed on traveling to Condos/Maps, the store was expanded with more shelves, we fixed issues where griefing could occur, made changes so that people can’t change what location you go to at the last second, added some sound effects, and added notifications when players are about to group up to travel.

The public beta will likely go up this week to test this out.

Optimization
Work has been ongoing with optimization to the Plaza. We’ve been reducing texture usage, adding more HLODs, optimizing models, and material usage.

Community Condos
Great progress continues to be made on Community Condos!

This week we’ve successfully concluded backend work for Community Condos and have been testing connecting dedicated Condos to our Condo server list. Next up is integrating the changes with the main game, which we plan to do for the Condo Rental Store beta. We plan to have more information about how to host a dedicated Condo during the public beta!

Cooking
Progress is being made on the recipes for cooking! We currently have 92 recipes planned out and plenty more to come. Work was done last week compiling the list of ingredients and outcomes, so now its just a matter of putting more of them together as recipes!

Plenty of the recipes involve fish you can find in the Plaza, and you’ll be able to make lots of different dishes just by using different preparation tools, like blending, grilling, or freezing!

Condo & New Items
Some major fixes were done in Condos, such as the ability to favorite items again. The rental shelves items also got some polish!

We’ve finished new items for the next update which include Cat Café items that will be ready when the Cat Café / Pets update comes out.

Work is also being done on double wide (and thin) variants for the Canvas Elbow and Tube. The tube has been reworked to use two variable sliders instead of one so it’s easier to select which size and division you want.

Miscellaneous Bug Fixes
There’ve also been quite a few fixes to notable bugs and some other changes. These include friends list fixes, a change where the votemap timer now pauses in singleplayer/private matches, further controller support, and bug fixes related to clicking on badges.

You can track all the upcoming changes on our Trello here: https://trello.com/c/56c2GvHb/799-update-1010

That’s a Wrap!
That’s going to do it for this week’s dev log! Be sure to keep an eye out for the next one, and let us know if you’re liking the new bi-weekly format.

notes.title: Controller Support Update (1.0.0.1)
notes.content:
Welcome to our first update post 1.0!

Controller Support Update!
In this update, 1.0.0.1, we have made major changes to the game to support controllers, along with adding controller icons that support multiple types of controllers. We currently support Xbox, Playstation, Nintendo, and Steam Deck controller icon sets.

ALL Game Worlds now have full controller support! Minigolf, Accelerate, Ball Race, Zombie Massacre, Virus, Little Crusaders, and SDNL now have full controller support, along with force feedback! Plaza activities such as Casino, Arcade, Bowling, Trivia, and Billiards all have controller support as well now!

Controller force feedback was improved across the game, adding rumble to various aspects of gameplay for all the Game Worlds. In Ball Race, bumpers will rumble like a bumper should, in Minigolf you'll feel the slight taps of the railings and the HIO rocket, and in Little Crusaders you will feel the Dragon's roar!

We added controller support to the menus, so you can enter and play game worlds, browse workshop maps, enter your condo or other condos, customize yourself, buy items, or check your collection book progress all with your controller.

This was a huge undertaking and project! We're still working on controller support for the hot bar/player emotes. We are also working on full compatibility with the Steam Deck and will have more news on that soon!


Public Betas
About two weeks ago, we started our first public beta as a test run to help get feedback on this 1.0.0.1 update. The beta testing went very well and we'll continue to use public betas going forward. 

We’ll have more formal announcements that these are going on in the future now that we’ve done this initial try!

To learn how to participate in the public betas, and to give feedback before an update goes live, check out: https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/tower-unite-public-beta-branches/53183

notes.title: Dev Log for May 12th, 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Welcome to the Tower Unite Dev Log for this week, which will have a new format!

Current Roadmap
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/0a9c151d110aa1949ed061de1ef394c97b5885d3.png
If you missed it, here is our Post 1.0 Roadmap featuring the major updates to come. Not every update is listed in this graphic, but you can see more detailed development progress on our Trello or Discord!

What’s New?
Tower Unite Version 1.0 was released on April 19th, 2025! We are so appreciative for the response from you all! And thank you for any bug reports, reviews, feedback, and support!

Since the release, we’ve been making progress on the roadmap updates slated for post-1.0. Progress is being made on the various roadmap projects all at once.

Next Update: Update 1.0.0.1
This next update will be a brief interlude before the Workshop Rental Store to fix some bugs, improve controller support, and prepare for future beta tests.

Controller Support
With the release of 1.0, controller support is a feature near and dear to our hearts. This next update includes great improvements for controller support in Plaza and Game Worlds to the benefit of controller and Steam Deck users alike!

Here is an overview of the controller support features that will be added:

 Game World Controller Support (ALL GAME WORLDS)
 Menu Controller Support (Game World Select, Workshop Browser, Character Customization, Collection Book)
 Force Feedback (Rumble)
 Controller Icons
 Scoreboard Controller Support
 Settings Controller Support
 Plaza Map Controller Support

Force Feedback (Rumble)
Controller force feedback will be improved across the game, adding rumble to various aspects of gameplay for all the Game Worlds. In Ball Race, bumpers will rumble like a bumper should, in Minigolf you’ll feel the slight taps of the railings and the HIO rocket, and in Little Crusaders you will feel the Dragon’s roar!

Controller Icons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a44f2ba8a73e48d3b66d3c4cb6f4ae71c5fcf5c6.jpg
With this update, we’ll also be adding controller icons that support multiple types of controllers. It will support Xbox, Playstation, Nintendo, and Steam Deck controller icon sets.

Menu Controller Support
We’re also adding controller support to the majority of the menus, so you can enter and play game worlds, browse workshop maps, enter your Condo or other Condos, customize yourself, or check your collection book progress all with your controller.

This has been a huge undertaking and project! We’re still working on controller support, so some of the various aspects of the game such as the hot bar are still lacking full controller support. Support for those are still being developed, as they require more work than other parts of the game.

We are also working towards full compatibility with the Steam Deck and will have more news on that soon!

We will continue to add more controller support to the game in each upcoming update!

Public Betas
About a week and a half ago, we started our first public beta as a test run to help get feedback on the 1.0.0.1 update. The beta testing went very well and we’ll continue to use public betas going forward.

We’ll have more formal announcements that these are going on in the future now that we’ve done this initial try!

To learn how to participate in the public betas, and to give feedback before an update goes live, check out: Tower Unite Public Beta Branches!

Workshop Condo Rental Store
The Workshop Rental Store grand opening is just around the corner! This will be our next Major update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/421029ec7b79315c4c795e37224bbd54136d4e16.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/452bb9dd43adbe985a91246fa47ff22527bad75d.png

A new expansion to the Condo Hub, the Workshop Rental Store displays both popular and recently released Workshop maps made by the community, allowing players to quickly grab them off the shelves and transport players to the map for easy browsing.

We are currently putting the final touches and will provide an open beta, so stay tuned and feel free to join in our open beta when announced.

Pets!
We’ve also been working on the new Condo pet system! We’ve made great progress on the pets, as they now have traits such as love and energy, and commands such as sit, follow, eating/drinking, and sleeping.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/30c111b0c5dfe7bca8bd9148e25685f6ded36964.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/69c94ee34e61949496a6c3fce5bdc35dc37fd3d6.jpg

We’ll have more information on the big pet update that comes out after the Rental Store update!

Community Condos
Community Condos are dedicated user-hosted Condos. Since the 1.0 release, we’ve made great progress on the backend changes needed for the server browser required for Community Condos in the game. Work will continue to be done on this feature.

Surprise Planet Panic Updates?
If you follow our Trello, you may have noticed work has resumed on a Game World, Planet Panic! Planet Panic was one of our earliest game worlds, but we had complaints about the gameplay design and the vehicle networking. The game simply wasn’t up to our standards. Since then, Planet Panic has been in development hell, constantly getting pushed aside due to lack of interest both by our community polls and developers. But all hope is not lost…

We’ve recently discussed some new exciting designs for the gameplay, got some inspiration, and now have developed fully working UFOs with network prediction! With the new gameplay, we hope to add more fun and challenge to the original concept while keeping the cute style.

Progress is also being made on reworking some of the old maps as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/3286026382abf7d5eec8c0d905efb33f67aeb81d.png

That’s a Wrap!
That’s going to do it for this week’s dev log! Be sure to keep an eye out for the next one. We’ll be changing from our weekly schedule to a more biweekly announcement with more information than our old dev logs.

notes.title: Leaving Early Access - Tower Unite Version 1.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=sYHVD-wrs_8;full][/previewyoutube]
Alright everyone, its time! We’ve been preparing for this moment for years, and with this update we’re sealing the deal:

Tower Unite is out of Early Access!!!
The dream of Tower has been part of some of our team’s lives for almost 20 years now, starting as our lead developer Mac’s highschool daydream in 2006. Now, it’s been 9 years with Tower Unite!

Time really does fly, doesn’t it?

Inspired by our love of theme parks, arcades, resorts, and a metric ton of love for gaming, we’ve been creating a loving place that has endless entertainment and fun, and we’re so happy to give it a big welcome in its 1.0 state!

Our wish was to make a jam-packed game that offers you the world and delivers it as best as it can – a place where friends can hop on and chill, play all sorts of games, and express yourselves in your own digital home.

We have been so humbled by the support we’ve been given. Early access has been an absolute gift, and you all gave us the opportunity to make Tower with our small team and work on the game at our own pace, adding the features we all wanted. It’s been a dream come true. The support from our committed community has been overwhelming, and we are so proud of how much Tower has grown.

With all of the work we’ve done on the game over the years, we feel Tower is ready and doesn’t belong in Early Access any longer.

This does not mean we are done!

Tower development is NOT over. We have games to make, promises we are determined to keep, and we will never stop coming up with new games and ideas for Tower Unite! And, of course, we want to do our best to deliver polish and improvements. This game is our passion.

So, while we’re saying goodbye to Early Access, we want to give you all some info about how future updates will work and are happy to announce our first roadmap for post 1.0!

How Will Updates Work Post 1.0?
If you’ve been following Tower’s journey, you’ve been beta testing the game with us with every update and providing feedback. Since we are leaving early access, we’ll be releasing future major updates on a public beta branch before they get launched into the main game.

This way players can continue to provide feedback on new features and test them before the general public.

In terms of communication updates, we’ll still be continuing our developer blogs; We’ll still be active on the forums and our Discord, and we’ll still be using Trello for updates. We’re committed to being transparent with Tower’s development, even after Early Access!

Bug Fixes Post 1.0
No developer wants bugs or issues with their game, and we are no different. We want Tower to work as best as it can, and are always going to figure out ways to improve performance, solve issues, and make the game an enjoyable experience for all players.

If you encounter a bug or other issue with the game, we continue to encourage you to let us know on our forums. Tower Unite has a large scope and a small team, so we are always grateful to players for letting us know issues when they arise, or giving us more information on known issues.

We’ll continue to deliver hot fixes and plenty of bug fixes and optimizations in every update.

Post 1.0 Roadmap
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/0a9c151d110aa1949ed061de1ef394c97b5885d3.png

Workshop Rental Store
A new expansion to the Condo Hub, the Workshop Rental Store displays both popular and recently released Workshop maps made by the community. This store will allow players to grab a map off the shelves and throw it into a special VHS portal device that will transport players to the map for easy browsing.

This feature is very close to being done, and it just needs some fine tuning. If you’ve followed development, you know this has been in our desired roadmap for quite some time, so we’re excited to get it out to you all.

Condo Pets & Cafe Miaou
We’re working hard on the new pet system, which will be one of the first post-1.0 updates. Pets will have the ability to walk around your Condo, follow you, eat, drink, sleep, and yes, you can pet them! Pets can be named, and you can form a bond with your pet by giving it care and attention.

With pets being added, you’ll need somewhere to adopt them. We’re very excited to finally share our progress on the new Cafe Miaou with all of you! Cafe Miaou will be a new store next to D.I.Y. and will be a place for players to adopt lovable cats to keep in their Condo.

Don’t worry dog lovers; there will also be a dog park in the Plaza, where you can adopt lovable dogs as well!

Community Condos
A much desired feature, Community Condos are dedicated user-hosted Condos. We plan to release Community Condos in stages. The first stage will be allowing players to host a dedicated Condo with their own Condo map and to show them on the new Community Condos server list. The second stage is to add editing support, so approved players can edit the layout of the dedicated Condo and spawn their own items. Community Condos will also have their own save system.

Cooking
Cooking is another project we are wrapping up development on! Plenty of food has been made, and the bulk of the work is now on the programming side.

Updates Beyond
We are fully engaged with developing the updates mentioned above, and we are working our hardest to be able to continue with future updates beyond these. If things go well, we’ll be able to tackle another game world, future arcade updates, and other various projects that have been in the plans from the start.

VR Support
VR development is one of the ongoing projects planned to be a feature of Tower. Converting a game with the scope of Tower Unite to VR is complicated, so it doesn’t have a planned date for now. However, we’ve been steadily making progress and have made huge strides in its development. We plan to roll out changes to VR throughout the months post 1.0.

Future Game Worlds
Future Game Worlds include Planet Panic, Death Run, and a horror Game World. We’ve mentioned it before, but the horror Game World’s scope has grown, so we’re still in the midst of redesigning it to better fit Tower.

Future Game World Maps
Now that we are in a post-1.0 state, our content developers will have more time to work on maps for existing Game Worlds.

We have plenty of Game World maps still in progress, such as Accelerate: Moon City, Virus: Theme Park, and SDNL: Skyline.

Other Upcoming Features to Tower
Tower will continue to grow, and we plan to expand on existing features, such as releasing new Arcade games and Boardwalk Attractions. New Game World Mutators and Upgrades are also in the works.

Other Developments
Tower Unite has been our sole project for a long time. Throughout development we’ve had many ideas and discussions about future games. We’re happy to say we’ve settled on a project we’re most passionate about! With Tower now in its post-1.0 state, we’re excited to finally announce our next game!

Introducing…

The Elevator
The ultimate sequel to Elevator: Source! We have been eager to share this with all of you.

The Elevator will be our second standalone game!

The Elevator is a 6+ player multiplayer game with extended gameplay based on Elevator: Source. For those who aren’t familiar, Elevator: Source is a game about taking a mysterious elevator on a journey to places beyond your imagination. We don’t want to give away too much, but some floors you may have to get off the elevator…

We plan to have more elevating information soon in a future announcement!

Final Thoughts & Early Access Overview
Thanks for sticking around to read this, to play the game, and to see Tower Unite grow. We make games because we love them, and gaming has been an important part of each of our lives. Tower is all about spreading that love!

We can’t wait to keep making games with you all along for the ride.

Below is an overview of every year of Early Access development, up to our last update. I’ve highlighted some updates that were significant in scale or were technical accomplishments for us. All of them are included as interesting parts of Tower’s history.

When you look at this overview, keep in mind that it only scratches the surface of bug fixes, back-end work, and other important changes that have gone on throughout development.

Dev Hangout
In celebration of 1.0, you can join us for a Dev Hangout today at 1PM Pacific Time on Twitch! We’ll be playing Tower and talking to you all about the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/d4e760057612baaab1cad2d4dfd98452760b24fb.jpg


THANK YOU
Thank you to our backers, early access players, supporters, patrons, and our inspiring community!

Thank you to those of you who submitted your custom maps & condos for our trailer, and thank you to those of you who joined us for trailer shots.

Thank you to everyone who filled out our Road to 1.0 feedback survey, and everyone who submitted bug reports, crash reports, and suggestions throughout the years.

Thank you to everyone who has been on or worked with our team in the past, to those who have given advice during development when we reached out for help, and to everyone who helped us keep pushing forward on this game.

Thank you for talking about the game, creating awesome things with it, and making memories in it, and forming new friendships!

Thank you for playing Tower Unite and being a part of this exciting journey!

We can’t wait for more!

We love you all,

notes.title: Sprays & Saves Update! (0.18.10.0)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/afdca3d4687000957df30902a1c9c86606f31f27.png

Player Sprays!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a3da295e0494372c7ddb00667dbfba359eb8b27b.jpg
We have been working on a selection of different sprays to be used in all areas of Tower Unite! Sprays are artwork you can spray on walls or the floor in the Plaza, Condos, and even Game Worlds. You can use sprays to express in a new way! You can spray by using the G key.

Sprays can be unlocked at the computer customization station in Tower Threads.

There are over 64 unlockable sprays!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/4a1f193e3655b228836120dcef9a639f062b1a9a.png
Like the profile backgrounds, we have a big batch of sprays for all players to use, as well as a few gift sprays for Supporter Pack 2 owners and a few for Patrons.

Aside from the gift sprays from the Supporter Pack 2 or the Patreon subscription, all sprays will be earnable with Units, Tickets, or event currency (ex. Ghoul Coins). Some require achievements to unlock as well.

Along with the functionality to use sprays, we’ve made a favoriting feature which allows for easy access through a ring menu shortcut (default holding G key).


Player Outfits!
You can now save preset outfits to be equipped from the appearance menu! This means you’ll be able to save your accessory and player model combos for easy access in the future. You’ll also be able to save workshop player models in an outfit. The outfit slots are unlimited, so you can go wild with expressing your different personal styles!

Outfits are also saved as small files you can share with other players (found in Tower Unite/Cloud/Outfits). Outfits are saved to Steam Cloud as well!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/0f605a9ad7b1f10a4ea454e5551ef9d278efb375.png


Condo Backups
Lost or corrupted Condos are a heartbreaking issue, so we wanted to make improvements to the system to provide backups and give further information on how saving works in this update.

Now, every time your Condo is saved, a backup will be saved to a file on your computer. These files will be zipped up to save space on your system. If you have an issue with your Condo and need to revert, this will give you a secure way to access your old saves.

Backups are stored in the game files, under Tower Unite/Backups/Condos. You can restore a backup by using the new Load From File feature in the Condo Save menu.

The backup system works even when Steam Cloud is down!


Coloring Accessories
Accessories are now colorable! You can now color most of the hats, glasses, and other appearance items in the game, with a few exceptions for some seasonal items. This is a thorough coloring system that allows you to color various parts of an appearance item like you would a Condo item! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/29dc8d10a7107a7b3ecd3eff61ca6e401b54d46b.png


Accelerate: 150CC!
There’s a new gamemode for Accelerate: 150CC mode! This mode will pick up the pace of your races and allow for new competition with its own leaderboards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/48e6456c3289bbcb5341d1da010ace0f45bd7729.png


Condo: Highrise Changes
Highrise had a bit more cleanup work done on it in this update! There were more changes that allowed for colorability, hiding map objects, light toggles, and additional map issues.


Plaza Auto Reconnect
Near the end of each day, we have our Plaza servers restart for maintenance. We now have a system that reconnects players to another Plaza automatically once the Plaza restarts for maintenance, reducing the need for you to have to search and find another Plaza during the maintenance.


Workshop SDK Improvements and Fixes
We've fixed a major issue with Condo IO Movers that affected published SDK maps. Now movers work for SDK maps!

The player model creation SDK now has the ability to preview all the wearables, so you can get a better idea how the offsets will look for all the accessories.

We also added better error handling when uploading workshop player models, specifically around creating the icon for the player model.


Game World Ports Connection Issues Fixed
In the last update, we found an issue that caused Game World Ports not to properly connect players when a game starts. This issue is now resolved!


Friends List Fixed
And lastly, we fixed the friend list not displaying your friend activities in this update.


We fixed lots of major bug fixes in this update, so be sure to check the change log below for more details!


New Items
 Added new items to Kalarry's: Storage Tank, Processing Tank, Oversized Gelatin, Explorer Cot, Explorer Tent, Dino Nest, Catzek Statuette
 Added new items to Vendy: Splurge Aesthetic Drink
 Added new items to Fresh: Bottle of Maple Syrup, Bottle of Honey, Kitchen Jars, Kitchen Cake Display
 Added new items to Rob's Imports: Payphone, Phone Booth (City) and (Royal), Rotary Phone, Push-Tone Phone, Wall Phone
 Added new items to Oasis: Tiki Dock Lamp
 Added new items to Seasons: Garden Gnome

Major Changes
 Added savable player outfits! Now you can save your player model and accessories combinations and colors
 Added new customizable - player sprays! Sprays can be unlocked at the computer customization station in Tower Threads. You can spray on most surfaces with the key bind G. If you hold G down, you can also select from favorite sprays. You can favorite sprays by going to the Appearance > Profile > Sprays and click on the star on the spray you'd like to favorite (you can favorite as many as you'd like)
 Added coloring wearable support! You can now color your hats, glasses, and more!
 Created a bunch of achievements icons that were missing from newly added achievements

Plaza Changes
 Plaza: Added auto reconnect to another Plaza if you are in a Plaza during its automatic maintenance restart
 Boardwalk: Milk Jug Toss now automatically ends after 8 seconds after the second ball is thrown
 Plaza: Added confirmation prompt when closing a store if you have items currently in the cart
 Added Casino tutorial
 Bingo: Added better feedback for when you get a bad blackout (now tells you which number you got wrong)

Game World Changes
 Accelerate: Added 150CC mode. This gametype speeds up the kart speeds and has its own leaderboards
 Accelerate: Restored boost speed to 75mph (original boost speed)
 ZM: Bosses now take less damage from melee and orbital lasers
 ZM: Player class (survivor, etc.) now show up better on name tags
 Virus: Reduced fire rate of Plasma Autorifle
 Virus: Increased damage of Plasma Autorifle
 Virus: Added "patient zero" tag on scoreboard so you know who was the first infected
 Virus: Added "survived for" progress bars to scoreboard

Condo Changes
 Condo: Added Condo backup system that backs up your Condo to your local disk instead of just Steam Cloud. This backup system will always save your Condo data even if Steam Cloud goes down. Backups are stored in Tower Unite's install folder Tower Unite/Backups/Condos/. Backups are made each time your Condo is saved by the game. Backup system is enabled by default but can be disabled in Settings > Game/HUD > Condos
 Condo: Added Load From File and Save To File to the condo saves menu so you can make your own condo save files and load backups or your own condo files without the need of using Steam Cloud
 Condo - Highrise: Lights in the Pool room are now customisable
 Condo - Highrise: All metal railings are toggleable
 Condo - Highrise: Wood panelling around the building is toggleable
 Condo - Highrise: Rafters, some columns, and an upstairs wall are now customisable

 Condo: Art pass on Wood Door item (renamed to Victorian Wooden Door), now has 3 variants

 Items: Added Splurge to the Soda Vending Machine item

Workshop SDK Changes
 Workshop SDK: Added the ability to preview workshop wearable offsets with any wearable item
 Workshop SDK: Moved preview wearable button up to prevent accidentally clicking on reset instead of preview
 Workshop SDK: Added image requirement details when uploading workshop avatars
 Workshop SDK: Before uploading, the workshop avatar uploader will check the file size of the avatar image to see if its too large
 Workshop SDK: When failing to upload, the workshop upload popup will no longer close completely and remove all of the name/description of the model you are trying to upload

Misc Changes
 Libretro: Added NeoCD core support
 Chat messages that are over the limit no longer clear from the chat box (on send) and now properly error
 Hot Bar: Moved edit option on items to the left of de-quip
 Inventory: Added Sweet Tooth props to Drink/Food inventory category and added Fireworks to Games category

Optimizations
 Optimized players and reduced tick rates

 Fixed Game World ports not traveling players to the host properly

notes.title: Weekly Dev Log for March 31st, 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to this week’s Tower Unite Dev Log!

March 2025 Condo Contest - 80s - RESULTS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/594ecc86739c4392fb227c71dd050c60dfa43add.png

Alright everyone, the results are in! 

There were 72 votes this time :) Thank you to everyone who participated in the vote and contest.

The winners are:

1st Place - 2,000,000 Units - @jun  
2nd Place - 1,000,000 Units - @jamlee11  
3rd Place - 750,000 Units - @Sithonious  
4th Place - 500,000 Units - @Noodles95  
5th Place - 300,000 Units - @Burns_Lord  

Very nice entries all around and a pretty close vote between all of them for the most part! 

Thanks again for joining and voting everyone. 

Hope to see you all in the next contest. You can check out all the entries at the link below.

March 2025 Condo Contest - PixelTail Games Forums

Miscellany

Johanna continued working on optimizations and bug fixes for the Plaza, getting it ready for 1.0.

Lifeless continued working on the Condo tutorial.

macdguy worked on finishing the Spray system, adding all of the sprays and artwork. He also worked on the condo backup system, adding compression and an optional automatic older backup deletion system. In addition, he fixed a major bug with movers in published maps, fixed some issues with the Votemap system, fixed Minigolf hats (coloring), fixed gibs in Virus, did a small audio pass on Hospital, and finished the outfit system.

Sketchman worked on bug fixes and optimizations.

wheezwer continued working on sprays, created the April event calendar and helped with the 1.0 Trailer.

That’s a Wrap!
Thank you for reading and we’ll see you all next week for more!

---

notes.title: Smoother Movement Quality of Life Update! (0.18.9.0)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/d4d1494176625ec27a95431254a0093456175179.png

This update includes massive improvements to network prediction for sprinting, walking, ladders, sliding, jumping, vehicle movement, and vehicle boosting.

Networking & Prediction Improvements
Networking has been a longstanding complaint, and it’s a complicated issue that has been a huge challenge in development. Networking affects how you and others experience actions in any online game, such as the visual smoothness of movement, viewing other players playing games, or general connection issues.

This update includes massive improvements to network prediction for sprinting, walking, ladders, sliding, jumping, vehicle movement, and vehicle boosting. This means you will be much less likely to see jerky movements or “rubber banding” while playing or watching others play.

These changes affect different areas all throughout the game, whether you’re in the Game Worlds, Plaza, or Condos. Game Worlds also got an overhaul with their movement such as SDNL sliding, LC dragon jumping, LC knight sprinting, and ZM power ups.

Accelerate Network Overhauled
With the improved networking, Accelerate feels and plays better in multiplayer. This has required us to rework the internals, but now there are no more network desyncs that would disrupt your racing!

Accelerate certainly got some love from the networking fixes, but there were other quality of life changes included in this update as well. We’ve adjusted the lap amounts for each map, improved handling and turning, and changed the speed of certain actions and power ups.

Ball Race
We’ve made improvements to the visual and audio experience of playing Ball Race. Additions include more visual/audio feedback for areas that have boosts, sound effects for more interactions, and  better contrast of colors for boosts and buttons on some maps.

Plaza
We’ve further optimized the Plaza with improvements to LODs, light/shadows, rendering, and item collision. We also fixed a large loading start-up hitch.

Jetpacks
With our networking changes, expect smoother jetpack movement! We’ve also made improvements to the lighting of jetpacks.

Singapore and AUS Plaza Servers
We addressed the connection issues with our APAC and AUS region Plaza servers and they are now back online.

TU is 30% off for Spring!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/394690/Tower_Unite/


Networking Changes/Bug Fixes
 Added better network prediction for sprinting, walking, ladders, vehicle boosting
 Fixed sprinting being horribly desynced and causing network lag when toggling it (effects Plaza, Condos, and Game Worlds)
 Fixed walking being horribly desynced and causing network lag when toggling it (effects Plaza, Condos)
 Fixed vehicle boosting being horribly desynced and causing network lag when boosting (effects Plaza, Condos)
 Fixed ladders being horribly desynced and causing network lag when using them (effects Plaza, Condos, and Game Worlds)
 Fixed jetpacks having lots of desyncs when using them
 Fixed network desync when moving around crouched
 Fixed network desync when equipping potions
 Fixed various pool tube related desyncs
 Accelerate: Completely eliminated all network related lag with boosts, powerups, dirt, and walls
 SDNL: Fixed sliding being desynced and causing network lag when sliding
 LC: Fixed all network desyncs with sprinting as a Knight
 LC: Fixed all network desyncs with jumping and flying as a Dragon
 ZM: Fixed network desync with using the survivor shield powerup
 Added better network prediction for jetpacks
 Improved jetpack dynamic lights

Changes
 Plaza: Art pass on stair steps throughout Plaza area
 Condo: Save button has been updated to directly go to the snapshots list
 Condo: When resetting your condo, it'll ask you one more time before clearing it
 Condo: When loading a snapshot, it'll now ask you to save your current condo as another snapshot before loading the snapshot
 Condo: Improved look of snapshot menu
 Condo: Added description of what snapshots are to the snapshot menu
 Condo: Snapshot date is now shown on the tooltip, so it's easier to find when a snapshot was made from the list
 Condo IO: Added video feed support to Camera IO items (connects to TVs) and added "Play" and "Stop" IO inputs to control its movement without having to enter the camera
 Condo: Media players now show "Play" when they have a playlist, otherwise it shows Turn On
 Condo: Added media player prompt override setting
 Trivia: Added new payout for getting a correct answer (single player or multiplayer supported) which will give you 100 units for each correct answer
 Workshop SDK: Added "skip updating description" option when uploading workshop player models/items

Game World Changes
 Accelerate - Bedzoom: Reduced Laps from 4 to 3
 Accelerate - Wishy Washy Waterfall: Reduced Laps from 4 to 3
 Accelerate - Pine Valley: Reduced Laps from 4 to 3
 Accelerate - Holly Jolly Highway: Reduced Laps from 5 to 3
 Accelerate - Sunrise Isles: Reduced Laps from 5 to 3
 Accelerate: Improved handling/turning
 Accelerate: Added controller DPad turning support
 Accelerate: Reduced respawn/fallout respawn delay (2s > 1s) to keep players in the race faster
 Accelerate: Reduced speed of Moon Power powerup
 Accelerate: Reduced slowdown of water
 Accelerate: Adjusted boost priority so that boosting is preferred even when powered up because boosts are faster
 Accelerate: Dirt slows you down more
 Minigolf: Added voice volume setting to Minigolf scoreboard
 Ball Race: Improved customize menu
 Ball Race: Booster pads now have sound and visual effects
 Ball Race: Boost pipes and boost fans now have visual and audio wind effects
 Ball Race: Added various ambient audio effects throughout the maps
 Ball Race: Slightly shrunk the kill volumes on the toxic sludge in Woodlands so that slightly touching/getting near the edges is a bit more forgiving
 Ball Race: Increased the amount of melons in Oasis's bonus level
 Ball Race: Improved button's glow effects to better indicate when a button is turned on.
 Ball Race: Added on/off click sound effects when triggering a button
 Ball Race: Pop-up blockers now play a sound effect when they spawn and despawn.
 Ball Race: GLXY, Khromidro, and Midori's floor tiles now match the location of the booster pads, making it more clear where exactly the boosts are
 Ball Race- Paradise: Boost pipes in Paradise now play a "thunk" sucked-into-a-pipe sound effect when entering.
 Ball Race - Paradise: Paradise's boost pipes now have a wrong way indicator.
 Ball Race - Prism : Changed some of the blocks to have translucent glass in the easy/hard course in Prism so that players can better see what they are doing without having their view obstructed
 Ball Race - Midori: Midori's platforms have gotten an art pass
 Ball Race - GLXY: Reduced distance to death volumes on most levels
 Ball Race - GLXY: Added more melons to Bonus Level
 Ball Race - Midori: Added more melons to Bonus Level


Optimizations
 Plaza: Various LOD improvements throughout the Plaza
 Plaza: Reduced collision complexity of hanging signs in stores area
 Plaza: Vastly improved the way the monorail bridge is rendered for improved performance
 Plaza: Optimized and re-did the way the lazy river is rendered for performance
 Plaza: Removed an unnecessary shadow-casting spotlight from the boardwalk that was causing a 2ms FPS drop when in the area
 Plaza: Optimized store creation by a huge amount, which will help reduce the initial load in freeze
 ZM - Escape: Optimized Suburbs

Bug Fixes
 Fixed high quality shaders setting not applying
 Fixed rich presence not setting to main menu when you return to the main menu
 Fixed jetpack not turning off when you de-quip it while using it
 Fixed underwater effect happening in third person
 Fixed water splash effects being missing from the game
 Fixed multi-buy purchase options showing up in stores that have no shopping cart
 Plaza: Fixed an improper collision at one of the monorail stations that was caused by an encircling railing having a box collision
 Plaza: Fixed one of the hanging signs in the stores area incorrectly listing Vroomspeed twice
 Plaza: Fixed the spotlight models glowing in Dark Voyage
 Plaza: Fixed collisions around the lazy river
 Plaza: Fixed Dark Voyage cart looking very dark
 Condo: Fixed post process volume not working with sphere shape
 Condo: Fixed Studio Headphones items fading out
 Arcade: Tutorial will now activate when entering any entrance
 Condo: Fixed Water Volumes not working with pool tubes (now pool tubes float properly)
 Condo: Fixed clients getting kicked from a condo when editing Sky Volume color properties
 Condo IO: Fixed Player Movement Volume not unsetting its effect on a player when a player dies/respawns while inside it
 Condo IO: Fixed Damage Heal Volume applying damage twice when first overlapped with
 Libretro: Fixed Libretro not displaying properly on OEM Computer, Laptops, and 90s / 80s TVs
 Workshop SDK: Fixed mover pause button not showing up in workshop level editor mode
 Fixed media player controls menu "Stop" button (bottom left corner) not working (clients were unable to hit the "Stop" button)

Game World Bug Fixes
 Accelerate: Fixed boost desyncing players
 Accelerate: Fixed turning speed adjustments desyncing players
 Accelerate: Fixed respawn boost netlag
 Accelerate: Fixed drift boost net lag delay
 Accelerate: Fixed starting race boost having network delay
 Accelerate: Fixed dragon animations always turning left/right wrongly
 Accelerate: Fixed drift angle not networking to other players (players drifting would appear not drifting at the correct angle or at all)
 Accelerate: Fixed item cards not clearing after respawning, causing item cards that appear usable but are not
 Accelerate: Fixed Flux powerup sound/effects playing twice/at a delay for clients
 Accelerate: Fixed Moon Power powerup sound/effects playing twice/at a delay for clients
 SDNL - Container Ship: Fixed various visual issues
 SDNL - Decommission: Fixed glowing ceiling lamps
 SDNL - Frostbite: Fixed glowing floor lights
 SDNL: Fixed broken lighting in SDNL's broadcast room (intermission room)
 LC: Fixed issues where players sometimes do not spawn in
 LC: Fixed player avatar scale on scoreboards
 ZM - Escape: Fixed an issue where spawning would cause you to fall forever
 Ball Race: Fixed customize menu being under the spectating menu
 Accelerate - Bedzoom: Lighting fixes

notes.title: Escape Update (0.18.8.0)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/336a08249f0f25e5de1efbb70f8163ed8f7e7e99.png

Zombie Massacre: Escape
This update includes the new Zombie Massacre map, Escape! Make your way to safety across 6 different locations as the horde comes after you. This is the first ZM map with alternate locations outside of the boss arena! It also is the first to incorporate sub-objectives.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/8c25eddd2b4bc4a1c6568ab898352dbb06a881a1.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/44414553191ab44342dfd9221e234acfb076a6f3.jpg


Plaza: Arcade and Bowling
Arcade physics have gotten some love in this update! The change improves the throwing responsiveness for Avalanche, Milk Jug Toss, Little Birde Feeders, Ring God, The Offering, Ice Cave, and Roll & Race.

Also, Pluck-a-Pal’s capsules have returned to help prevent prizes from getting stuck!

For bowling, thanks to your feedback and our testing, we’ve made even more major fixes to reduce desync issues and improve physics overall. We also did a sound pass and small art improvements to the bowling alley!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/e8e2b49fc397b16823af0e1f8265d0b358d7fff4.jpg

Graphics Profiles
We’ve implemented graphics profiles to quickly adjust your game graphics using our recommended graphic defaults. We also made versions of this for Steam Deck and VR.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/c05b3e57544888fc0621e4a87be6fd286fb422f4.jpg

Condo I/O Networking Improvements
We have decreased the amount of bandwidth required to load in a new player substantially, which will improve networking with other players while using Condo I/O.

New Store: Kalarry’s Wares
A new store is open in the Plaza! Here you can purchase milestone items (if you have reached the milestone), Game World props, and a few other goodies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/f4bc269aefb8b58ffe97f7ef2b1e556b9b930911.jpg

notes.title: SDNL Announcer / Bowling Physics Update (0.18.7.0)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1796f889aed54c09772917d9f29bb83f0373e359.png


We're super excited to bring you this packed update, which contains the new SDNL Announcer, Bowling Physics Rework, Accelerate Mirror Mode and Coin Paths, finished Arcade Milestones, Billiards fixes, and more!

SDNL Announcer!

It's been over a year since we got the SDNL Announcer lines recorded by voice actor Gianni Matragrano, and we're so excited to finally have them in the game! Testing them has been a blast, and we hope you guys have as much fun with them as we did making the announcer come to life.

The announcer has reactions for tons of different scenarios like:
 Introducing the gametype
 Getting a kill
 Dying
 Environmental Deaths
 Getting a special weapon kill
 Capture the Flag
 And intermission comments
The new announcer breathes a lot of life and joy into SDNL and helps push the TV theme of Slaughter Day Night Live! So hop on in there and get some frags!


Bowling Physics Rework!!

We have redone the networking for Bowling from the ground up! Previously Bowling would have slow-mo physics, or pins freezing in mid-air, etc. It wasn't great. With this rework, we have addressed these issues and Bowling's networking is more reliable and the issues have been drastically reduced. This has been a major bug for a long time, and was highly reported in our feedback survey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/3e9aeaa5d9c94a075ac9d2e24f435e6b9f359ef5.jpg

Billiards Fixes

We have fixed core networking issues with Billiards, fixing the game getting busted on second play and Billiard balls not scoring properly. Billiards should be now be fully playable in this update, but we still have a few issues to work out with it.


Accelerate: Unit Routes & Mirror Mode

Accelerate Unit Routes are now active and you can collect units while driving into the Unit marked track sections. Collecting Unit coins gives you a Unit bonus at the end of an Accelerate round, but at the cost of potentially losing your placement in the race if you're not quick about it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/ada5cb730b21eb09cf6a5964ccfb99dae596507e.jpg


We also added Mirror Mode, a game type that mirrors the track, so you can play your favorite tracks in a new way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/778cf1f2d2ebb86aea38eb53bc8a57347020492e.png


Arcade Milestone Items Finished!

We have finished all the Arcade milestone items in this update. There is:
 Pluck-a-Pal crane - a new hookshot-like weapon milestone
 Ticket Spewer - a gun that fires a stream of tickets
 Shooting Gallery Rifle - a rifle taken from the shooting gallery

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/094c46bc1a7906592de8549f4781bc1422600737.png

Those of you who have already unlocked these milestone weapons will see these items usable immediately.


SDNL: Lookout + SDNL: Containership

This update includes a new SDNL map, Lookout! Get a whole new perspective on the verticality-focused Acrophobia map from Zombie Massacre as you fight to the death (and for the ratings) in first person. Watch your footing!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/55c0b46c9f0682c39d6cf3dc0b1bf05eb13c58dd.jpg

We also took in feedback on Containership and reworked the layout in various ways to help improve gameplay, movement flow, and visibility, with a focus on the central area of the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/9a12a7568c367c517344f161ca79cd4e746a1548.jpg

New Condo Items

A small batch of new items such as Watermelon, Cheese Wheel, Heavy-Duty Shelf, Milk Crate, and Metal Signs (Traffic, Road Condition, Informational, etc.) have been released. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/05cd9811f19d88f14fe273e2500abe7cdccf1764.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/2d8ed0793d726d988798ff3d2666b1fe5a691daf.png

notes.title: Shooting Gallery Update (0.18.6.0)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/8f3e4710935325b2bdfa70d1e6171dab7db3b1d7.png

The Shooting Gallery is here!
The Arcade Shooting Gallery and the Boardwalk Shooting Gallery are now open!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1923538bb15c3255831b7cc7b7c15f10be3dc73e.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/812c3ee1879f31bb5001a1c49dcaa0c72ae1d344.jpg
A double feature of shooting galleries! 

Blast the evil corns that have taken over the garden in Corn of the Dead, the Arcade shooting gallery! This shooting gallery features multiple targets and 3 rounds.

Grab a rifle and precisely shoot the targets in the classic Western Shootout at the boardwalk! This shooting gallery is more simple and is more about precision than the other one.

Both shooting galleries feature their own achievements and leaderboards!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a0f0e421590c08c4d6dc72edd36c622274e289e7.jpg


Various Bug Fixes & Optimizations
On top of the new shooting galleries, we have been focused on bug fixes and optimizations in this update, tackling bugs that players have reported in our feedback survey for the road to 1.0. There are over 50 bug fixes in this update and several quality of life changes, along with additional optimizations to the Plaza and the game itself.

New Standard Player Models
Previously shown on our dev logs, we have replaced the stock player models with our own custom made ones. These player models have more color customization and various outfits to choose from.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/fe18241cc207aa59706233927922e03436381e6b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/8aee99f723f144896ab47c4d85d6b83926ae9b3e.jpg

New D.I.Y. Interior
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/46bdc016a7dd513b34f86aeb44289935fda42a18.jpg
D.I.Y.'s store interior was pretty lack-luster and something we didn't feel was up to the same standards of the other stores, so we redid its interior! Wonder what else will take up the real estate that opened up next door...?

Updated Appearance Editor
The appearance editor has a couple of new quality of life improvements such as a search bar and categories, making it easier to find your accessories.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/c0ff894c4893c11173674d4cbafc30278d300c60.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/74e93f4ac49833a0be82ee84feb811cd5ef74cc3.png

New Items
We also added new items, such as new food items, new lamps, vintage items, and some new gardening tools.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/2e5f96693cdc38e2dff70bc8f6a47a6a16598927.png

Changes

 Arcade: Corn of the Dead Shooting Gallery now open!
 Boardwalk: Western Shootout Shooting Gallery now open!
 New Standard Player Models
 Plaza: New D.I.Y. store interior
 Added categories for player profile backgrounds in appearance menu for easier finding
 Appearance menu now shows your current wearing accessory on the each tab
 Appearance menu now has a search bar for easily finding your accessories
 Stores now have a "Wear" button on wearable items for quickly wearing wearable items you have unlocked
 Added sub-categories for hats and other wearables in appearance menu
 Improved inventory item tags to make it more clear to new players. Added holdable, weapon, and equippable pet tags. Made equippable, wearable, milestone, unlockable tags larger than the other tags as they are more important
 Plaza: Condo inventory is now hidden while in Plaza to avoid confusion for new players. You can access your inventory from the pause menu
 Plaza: Added item currencies to HUD when you open the hot bar to quickly see your status on Sea Dollars, Anniversary Coins, Ghoul Coins, Holiday Coins, and Gold Catsacks
 Plaza: Added info markers for Dark Voyage, Vroomspeed, Bumper Cars, and She
 Plaza: Art pass on nature store
 Plaza: Art pass on nature store's greenhouse
 Plaza: Art pass and optimization on tower's chamfered corners
 Plaza: Improved LODs for theater exterior


New Items

 Rob's Imports: Brass Table Lamp, Brass Floor Lamp, Brass Wall Lamp, Fancy Candelabra, Metal Bucket, Rake, Pitchfork, Wheelbarrow, Watering Can, Shovel, Typewriter, Service Bell, Vintage Floodlight (lamp from Catzek)
 Central Circuit: Ceramic Table Lamp, Poseable Desk Lamp, Industrial Fluorescent Ceiling Lamp, Industrial Spotlight, Hanging Kitchen Lamp, Metal Shaded Wall Light
 Toy Stop: Oversized Chess Piece
 Fresh: Rice Bag, Box of Pasta, Egg Carton, Can of Peas, Bread Loaf, Canvas Tin Can
 Snackbar: Soft Pretzel (and Holdable)


Game World Changes

 Accelerate: Criss Cross Rapids laps reduced from 4 laps to 3
 Accelerate: Hallway Raceway laps reduced from 4 laps to 3
 Accelerate: Riptide Retreat laps reduced from 5 laps to 3
 Accelerate: Criss Cross Rapids, Hallway Raceway, Riptide Retreat are now separated in their own maps, improving load times for those maps
 Accelerate: Improved engine sounds to be more dynamic, now will adjust based on the speed of the kart, drifting, airborne
 SDNL: Adjusted gun game weapons (mixed some regular weapons with the super weapons) and removed camera from gun game
 SDNL: Increased payouts a bit (50>100 units per kill)
 ZM: Added new achievement for slaying the TRex boss


Libretro Changes

 Libretro: Updated cores to 2025 versions, except for Citra and Stella due to compatibility issues with Tower. Downgraded Flycast to a version that does not crash Tower. Downgraded DOS Box to a version that has input that is compatible with Tower
 Libretro: Added support for latest MAME core, labeled as MAME 2025. MAME 2010 is still supported as it has better lightgun support than the mainline MAME core at the moment. You will have to change your machines to use the latest MAME core manually, otherwise it'll still continue to use the 2010 version
 Libretro: Added DOSZ, EXE, BAT, ISO, CUE, IMG, IMA file support to DOSBox


Optimizations

 Fixed a common hitch in the game
 Plaza: Lots of various optimizations across the Plaza
 Optimized chat message system
 Optimizations to various game asset loading with a focus on improving load times
 Plaza: Translucency thread optimizations in Plaza
 Plaza: Numerous optimizations throughout plaza
 Plaza: DIY Store optimization
 Plaza: Optimization on nature store
 Plaza: Optimization on nature store's greenhouse
 Plaza: Optimized static mesh data in Toy Store, Arcade, Lighthouse, and Nightclub
 Enabled HZB Occlusion


Bug Fixes

 Plaza: Fixed various milestone weapons not reloading ammo properly after respawning/dying
 Plaza: Fixed hidden plushies not being interactable

 Plaza: Fixed Vroomspeed, Central Fountain, and new Casino Entrance missing location volumes

 Arcade: Fixed price of brain slug hat not matching label
 Plaza: Updated inventory refresh to help with appearance list not updating when buying new items sometimes
 Plaza: Fixed up info marker positions for boardwalk and new D.I.Y.
 Boardwalk: Fixed bumper car playtime not incrementing

Game World Bug Fixes

Workshop SDK Bug Fixes

notes.title: Hot Fix 0.18.5.1
notes.content:
This update fixes several bugs from the last update, along with addressing disconnect issues.

Addressing Disconnects
Last year we pushed a bug fix for issues with billiards, arcade, and other games where game objects would seemingly not spawn. We did this by correcting a race condition we found in Unreal's net driver. Due to the disconnects people are experiencing though we've decided to temporarily remove this fix, as it is possible the issues are related. 

If the disconnects continue, then we'll know it's not related to our net driver changes and we can re-apply the fix. If the disconnect issues stop, then we at least have some idea of where they're likely coming from. 

We appreciate everyone's patience while we get to the bottom of this issue, and will let everyone know as soon as we have a better understanding of what's happening. In the meantime this means that you may experience the previous bugs with billiards, arcade, and so on.


Changes

 Minigolf - Dino Drive: Removed all friction on HIO funnels, fixing players getting stuck on HIO funnels
 Adjusted materials on a bunch of wooden items to be more consistent
 Major art pass on Fireplace items and made them functional lights
 Updated Chessboard item to use new pieces and only have 3 draw calls, variants, and colouring
 Improved materials on Chandelier item
 Holdable Hot Dog now takes 4 bites to eat as opposed to 1
 End of Holiday events


Bug Fixes

 Possible fix for Game World/condo disconnections
 Minigolf - Dino Drive: Fixed OOB in ditch in Hole 8
 Minigolf - Dino Drive: Adjusted Hole 16 (Bone Vortex) to make the HIO more consistent
 Minigolf - Dino Drive: Fixed a stuck spot in Bone Pit HIO
 Fixed Canvas Doormat not applying rotation on load
 Fixed Hot Chocolate visual states being reverse (empty when full, filled when eaten)
 Fixed IES on various lights
 Fixed Bumper Post condo item not being colourable

Welcome to Dino Drive, where dinosaurs* and golf balls can live together just as they did millions of years ago. Explore a highly themed, outdoors minigolf course before braving the blacklight depths of the monster golf course known as the Extinction Zone.

notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to this week’s Tower Unite Dev Log!

Winter 2024-25 Condo Contest

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1d977ea1d811ffc13968422f43d855a269e768d2.png

Hey everyone,

The 2024-25 Winter Condo Contest has started!

As usual, we’re doing a Winter / Festivity theme.

So, your build should be either: winter-related, themed after winter holidays / holiday activities (including New Years), or generally wintry and festive!

The submission period ends on January 22nd, 2025 at 11:59 PM.

Click here for details!

Next Update

We're hard at work and very close to completion on our next update, which we're aiming for release this week.

The upcoming Plaza update is heavy on optimizations, bug fixes, and new additions! We’ve fixed over a hundred Plaza related bugs in this update!

It'll also bring with it new Holiday items, and a bunch of highly requested items.

You can read everything slated for this update on our Trello page.

Miscellany

Johanna worked on wrapping up the changes to the Plaza for the next update.

Lifeless spent some time working on Accelerate, specifically with issues with rubber-banding when boosting. He also worked on separating the tracks, making them individual maps instead of one map with two different tracks.

macdguy worked on bug fixes and Plaza changes for the next update. He also setup the Vroomspeed store, and worked on leaderboards, achievements, audio passes, and special Minigolf hazards for the Minigolf map, Dino Drive.

Nuclearxpotato worked on implementing food items for Cooking. He also continued working on the backlog of requested furinture items, this week working on Vintage Filing Cabinets, a Utility Cabinet, some Booth Sectional pieces, a Wood Four-post Bed, and a Brass Frame Bed.

Sketchman continued working on optimizations and fixes for the next update, specifically focusing on optimizations with the Lobby Scoreboard, a reduction in hard references (which should help with loading times), and more.

Upcoming New Furniture Items

That’s a Wrap!
Thank you for reading and we’ll see you all next week for more!

Winter Holiday Events are here! 

There are three exciting Holiday Quests to participate in! 

Spread holiday joy and help Santa Claws deliver gifts to the hardworking Plaza staff, share the joy of hats, and find the missing reindeer!

Find the quest-givers in the Central Fountain area!

In addition, the usual Holiday cheer has swept through Tower Unite! Enjoy beautiful holiday decorations in the Plaza, earn Holiday Coins from playing games, and deck yourself out with some festive gear at Santa Claws’ store!

As we've been saying, we've been working hard on bug fixes, which this new Plaza update addresses. This is all a part of the Road to 1.0.


DECEMBER EVENTS CALENDAR

notes.title: Bug Fixes Update (0.18.3.0)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/42b95f1d310071a499cf791049fc637f30a527cb.png

Hey everyone! Now that we’ve stated our plans for the “Road to 1.0”, we’re here with a first update to tackle reported bugs!

This update includes over 90 fixes to areas of the game that have had issues pop up in the recent updates, as well as long standing bugs.

Feedback Survey
Before we get into the fixes, we wanted to mention our Feedback Survey once again!

Provide Feedback on our Feedback Survey

We’ve already been getting a ton of responses and have gotten to work on major bugs that have been reported there in addition to ones we already knew about!

If you want to fill out the feedback survey, we seriously appreciate it and it is of great help to us as a small team!

PLAZA FIXES

We’ve tackled bugs and made gameplay tweaks in the Plaza.

These include fixes to Arcade, Casino, Fishing, Minigames, Dark Voyage, and more!

The fishing ponds should now be functional (excluding the peninsula), and there have been fixes to general gameplay as well.

In the Casino, fixes were made to Aces and they are now calculated properly as high or low in all card games, soft locks were fixed, bingo cards no longer display on the wrong screens, and Silver Saddles now properly returns your bet if you win.

In the Arcade, Coin River, Dragon’s Treasure, Coloracle, Cow Wheel, and Balloon Pop have all had major fixes, as well as fixes to LODs.

In Dark Voyage, player guns no longer block your view, allowing you to enjoy the game without your friends getting in the way.

Other fixes are detailed in the changelog below!

GAME WORLD FIXES

This update includes many fixes for collision issues and spawn points in Virus: Subway. 

Ball Race, Zombie Massacre, SDNL, and Virus all had fixes to visual issues, gameplay, and collision, respectively.

There were also fixes and improvements for Sub-Objectives in Zombie Massacre, and SDNL grav glove prediction improvements.

CONDO FIXES

Several fixes have been made for item collision desyncs, visual issues, and other minor map issues in Highrise, Underwater, and Resort Condos! Also, hiding items now saves!

Further changes are detailed below! Again, we greatly appreciate any feedback in our feedback survey, forums, or other comments!

PLAZA FIXES COMING NEXT

We are hard at work on the major Plaza changes which will include the new Casino entrance & outside area, new fishing peninsula, and various fixes and optimizations.

Changes

 Virus: All weapons now automatically reload when their clip is empty (if they have ammo)
 You can now rotate your camera (without rotating yourself) while on the broom stick after pressing right click
 Player Profiles: Made friends only status a lot more noticeable. Removed the underline effect and added an icon
 Player Profiles: Made location status a lot more visible on bright backgrounds
 Added mature condo filter support to Condo Hub
 Typing Derby: Added an animation when you fail a word
 Condo: Fixed stashed item notifications duplicating multiple times (now it combines all the recent notifications into one)
 Arcade: Optimized leaderboards
 Casino - Bingo: Added mouse mode toggle (space key), which will keep the camera static on the board and enable mouse input allowing you to select without moving your view
 Added circular variant to Mirror Panel item, and support for future shapes


New Items

 Added Thanksgiving 2024 Player Profile Background to Celebrations
 Added Basic Garage Door to D.I.Y.
 Added Basic Windowed Garage Door to D.I.Y.
 Added Glass Garage Door to D.I.Y.
 Added Basic Door Frame (Half) (w/ 6 shapes) to D.I.Y.
 Added Basic Window Frame (Half) (w/ 6 shapes)  to D.I.Y.
 Added Basic Window Frame (w/ 6 shapes) to D.I.Y.
 Added Rope Fence (w/ 7 variations) to D.I.Y.
 Added Victorian Gate to D.I.Y.
 Added Shutter Door to D.I.Y.


Plaza Bug Fixes

 Arcade: Fixed coin pushers
 Arcade: Fixed issues with Coloracle
 Arcade: Fixed issues with Cow Wheel
 Arcade: Fixed soft lock with Arcade and Boardwalk Games when first playing them (such as Milk Jug Toss leading to not being able to toss the ball)
 Arcade: Fixed Prismatic ending too early when there's still balls in the maze
 Arcade: Fixed LOD of Wheel of Fire sign
 Arcade - Pluck-a-Pal: Fixed sheep plush being too big in Pluck-a-Pal making it impossible to grab
 Arcade - Pluck-a-Pal: Fixed collisions with Obnoxious Citrus for Pluck-a-Pal
 Boardwalk - Balloon Pop: Fixed balloons not always making a pop sound and also improved the pop sound
 Boardwalk - Balloon Pop: Fixed top left balloon popping immediately preventing you from winning the game
 Boardwalk - Balloon Pop: Fixed balloons not popping for spectators
 Boardwalk - Milk Jug Toss: Added settle delay to ensure the milk jugs have settled before ending the game
 Dark Voyage: Fixed guns from other players blocking your view (now they fade out)
 Casino - Video Poker: Fixed ace pairs not counting as jacks or better
 Casino - Video Poker/Poker: Fixed ace not calculating as low or high properly
 Casino - Blackjack: Fixed being able to double down on a natural blackjack, causing bet calculation issues
 Casino - Silver Saddles: Fixed your bet towards a winning horse not being rewarded back to you
 Casino - Bingo: Fixed cards being assigned to the wrong screens
 Casino: Fixed long-standing issue where you could not get up from their slot machine if you just did an action or spun the wheel
 Fishing: Fixed not being able to move bobber in one of the fishing pond
 Fishing: Fixed fish sometimes spawning too far out from the range of the bobber radius
 Fishing: Fixed fishing cast circle having visual glitch
 Trivia: Fixed Top Total Score leaderboard not updating while playing single player
 Trivia: Fixed many issues where players would not be put into the seats properly, or could get the game to soft lock
 Trivia: Fixed an issue where you could not be able to cast to a response with keyboard shortcut sometimes
 Halloween: Fixed pumpkin placements in Plaza (ones that were clipping or floating)
 Halloween: Fixed trick or treat candy buckets blocking camera
 Typing Derby: Fixed some exploits


Condo Bug Fixes

 Condo: Fixed items that are hidden being desynced with clients who late join
 Condo/SDK: Fixed needing to double click to change item targets on condo IO connections
 Condo/SDK: Fixed "Goto" condo IO connection feature not working properly
 Condo: Fixed unset canvas material displaying as Sky Space
 Condos: Resort - Fixed gap in floor underneath Suite doors
 Condos: Resort - Fixed water in fountain being solid
 Condos: Resort - Fixed landscape near pool weirdly glitching out
 Condos: Resort - Fixed Z fighting in the store area
 Condos: Resort - Fixed small gaps in Arcade stairs
 Condos: Highrise - Adjusted collision on stairs in living room to better fit the actual model
 Condos: Underwater - Fixed several surfaces that were editable, but visually would not change
 Condos: Underwater - Fixed several surfaces that were not editable
 Condos: Underwater - Adjusted water physics volume so that items actually float on top of the water rather than just underneath
 Condos: Underwater - Fixed a light visually staying on in Satellite Condo 4
 Condos: Underwater - Adjusted seaweed too close to windows
 Condos: Underwater - Fixed spelling mistake in Location volume
 Condos: Underwater - Adjusted post process volume underwater
 Condo/SDK: Fixed floating chat messages not clearing when dying while inside the radius or when an SDK map ends
 Condo/SDK: Fixed floating chat not clearing when the floating chat item is destroyed
 Condo IO: Fixed Camera IO not setting FOV properly if players have a different FOV set from the default FOV
 Condo: Fixed custom item names taking priority of item types when grouped by type (would display a custom item name instead of Canvas Cube x4) in Item Finder
 SDK: Fixed camera fade module causing hidden items to become visible


Item Fixes

 Fixed Carnivorous Plant not playing sound packs properly
 Fixed Flying Eyeball Pet not displaying
 Fixed Canvas Necronomicon not displaying for clients
 Fixed hat crab scale
 Fixed potion equipping being applied to clients if the host is toggling the potions
 Fixed broom stick animations being offset for players who are smaller scale
 Fixed Damage Heal Volume rate value being ignored and not functioning
 Sound Emitter: Fixed workshop sound emitters not resuming at the correct position when you walk away from their hearing radius
 Sound Emitter: Fixed pitch adjustment not updating playback duration properly
 Sound Emitter: Fixed workshop sound emitters playlists not working (would not advance to the next sound)
 Fixed FPS issues while equipping the crossbow milestone item


Game World Bug Fixes

 Gib system: Fixed top half gib ragdoll not working for workshop models (it would freeze mid-air)
 Fixed player profile backgrounds not updating on waiting for players menu
 ZM: Fixed sub-objectives not starting for clients
 ZM - Gasoline: Adjusted zombie spawns to prevent dead zones
 ZM SDK: Optimized zombie spawners
 Virus - Subway: Prevented players getting on top of benches they shouldn't
 Virus - Subway: Adjusted collision around no-entry ticket barriers
 Virus - Subway:  Fixed broken spawn point
 Virus - Subway:  Fixed collision of pipes that stuck out way further than their geometry
 Virus - Solar: Fixed horde mode only blockers (and ramp) still having collision in non horde mode in Solar
 Ball Race - Event Horizon:  Fixed issue where small blackholes wouldn't kill you when you approached them slowly
 Ball Race - Khromidro:  Fixed water flickering in and out of existence when looking straight down
 SDNL: Fixed grav glove kills only awarding achievement/stat progress for the host (now it works for clients too)
 SDNL: Added client side prediction when carrying an object with the grav glove (fixes grav glove lag when carrying)
 SDNL: Fixed kills payout displaying when you have 0 kills
 SDNL - Meadows: Physics crates now respawn when there is not enough of them anymore
 Minigolf - Forest: Fixed sky in Forest being dark
 Minigolf: Fixed issues with spectating camera defaulting at a weird angle wrongly
 Minigolf: Fixed issues with spectating camera not handling collisions properly


Bug Fixes

 Fixed SDK maps not loading sometimes on first time play if you click on host quickly
 Fixed head not hiding in First Person Legs mode
 Fixed your head being missing in mirrors while in First Person Legs mode
 Fixed wearables not drawing in mirrors in first person when First Person Legs are enabled
 Fixed the broom stick leg physics for workshop models
 Fixed player model textures breaking when de-quipping a workshop model while in a vehicle
 Fixed appearance cameras going to the floor when editing appearance while in a vehicle
 Fixed Ghoul Coins being falsely rewarded multiple times
 Fixed chat rules popup not closing if you close the chat window without closing the chat rules popup
 Fixed names on collection book leaderboards being hard to read
 Fixed vehicles lagging when you press the alt key
 Fixed name tags of players you have one-way blocked not hiding when you just blocked them
 Fixed rolling pets of players you have blocked showing up (now they will not be there)
 Fixed vomit emote effects of players you have blocked showing up (now it will not be there)
 VR: Fixed your head and wearables being missing in mirrors
 VR: Fixed camera centering/initialization issues
 VR: Fixed VR main menu not being interactable



Known Major Issues That Will Be Fixed In Next Plaza Update

Pluck-A-Pal on boardwalk has horrible physics (specifically that one machine)
Bowling alley shows your wearables in first person
Dark Voyage level streaming issues
Peninsula water is not a fishing spot
Lots more TBA

notes.title: The Road to 1.0!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/32137f2cd4870be87b59c0a430424017b15355d1.png

:stars: 1.0 IS ON THE HORIZON!
It’s been a long time coming, but we’re finally at a point where our next goal is a 1.0 release for Tower Unite.

We’ve been itching to tell you guys about this exciting next step for Tower, and we can’t wait to have you all in the mix of making this dream a reality!


:stars: WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/43489a567482a29a28127d18f4045f07c59168f6.jpg
Releasing to 1.0 is going to cover a lot of ground that has been long-awaited!

Updates will be focused on getting the game to a more stable and functional position.

There will, of course, be map releases and in-progress content updates coming up, but we mainly want to get the game to a place where we will be proud to call it version 1.0!


:stars: HOW YOU CAN HELP!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/ebbe7da64bb3c8c6f68d7e9aff6eede926153fe3.png

We’ve set up a feedback survey to get some insights on the game!

You can fill out the survey to whatever extent you like, and feel free to come back and add to your submission later.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/8583f8cf38d7f9833f8f87abc119be8329de66cc.png

You all have been so great at helping us out this year, and we’re happy to still be around after all this time being carried by you guys.

We’re still struggling financially and trying to stay afloat as best we can without breaking the team apart. If you want to support us financially while we push to get Tower in great shape, we’d be extremely grateful.

Your support is always appreciated. If you aren’t able to support us financially, please try to get the word out about Tower to friends!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2792910/Tower_Unite__Supporter_Pack/

We also have another plush campaign going on with Makeship, if you want to support that!


:stars: 1.0 IS NOT THE END!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/b66a8521975c5af78c66dec3f358c494f074a72e.jpg
The 1.0 Release is focused on game stability, performance, and major bug fixes. We will be resolving long-standing issues that have been brought up throughout Tower’s existence.

Now that we have a huge percentage of the content that was intended for Tower Unite, we are ready to leave early access.

We will still be providing further updates on Tower after 1.0. Leaving early access does not mean the game will stop having updates. Tower has always been a passion project and we have plenty of ideas and projects to improve the game. As many know, this game is constantly evolving.


:stars: WHAT WE’VE BEEN UP TO
So far, on the Road to 1.0, we’ve been handling major bugs!

We’ve been already planning for 1.0 before this post, taking care of major bugs such as Workshop, Arcade optimizations, Plaza optimizations, Bowling, and other major areas of the game.

In previous updates, we’ve resolved major issues with Billiards, Pluck-A-Pal, Little Crusaders, Condo I/O, and a lot more.

Expect to see more major issues resolved, long-standing issues first, then more general fixes and polish.

:question: DISCONTINUED & DELAYED PROJECTS
During this transition, we’ll be re-organizing our Trello. Many features on Trello have been seemingly dormant publicly, but internally they’ve had progress. However, there’s a few projects that we need to discuss.

For the foreseeable future, we are uncertain that we’ll be able to complete the following:

Mac Support
Discontinued because: the requirements for the platform have changed drastically since we first announced support for this platform. It would be of great cost to us at this time due to hardware and developer costs.

Linux Client
Discontinued because: Linux client is no longer required thanks to Proton. The Proton port has been very stable. We have a developer who uses Linux daily and they play Tower through Proton exclusively. We are suggesting that Linux users use Proton to enjoy Tower.

Arcade 2D API
Discontinued because: Before we added Libretro support, we wanted to have our own Arcade 2D API for players to create games with. We ran into many issues and security concerns during its development. Knowing this, we worked on adding Libretro support to provide the same experience without the security concerns.

The below projects are delayed, but not discontinued.
Many are in different stages of development.

 Game World: Horror Hill - This game world is still in development for a post 1.0 release. We plan to have more announcements on it in the future. We originally conceived a Game World for this that ended up being too large for Tower, so we are in the middle of redesigning it to better fit Tower.
 Game World: Planet Panic - This game world has had various amounts of redesign. We have put this one on the backburner based on very low community votes and have prioritized other game worlds and projects. We intend to have a demo post 1.0 release.
 Condo: Cooking - Cooking is nearly complete. We have been working on it in the background. We had to change a lot of the crafting code to handle Steam requests better as in the past Steam API’s have been a tad bit unreliable. This will be included in a post 1.0 update.
 Condo: Condo Pets - This will be included in a post 1.0 update.
 Plaza: Ocean Expansion - We will have more information about this feature post 1.0.
 Plaza: Workshop Condo Rental Store - We have the backend code for this completed and we are just waiting on free development time to complete this feature. It’s a feature we added later on in the stages of Condo Hub and less priority than other features.
 Plaza: Dueling - Due to concerns with Plaza performance and lower ranking on community polls, dueling has been on the back burner. We have been planning on redesigning our original idea and possibly moving the arena map into SDNL.

We understand that many players are waiting on these features exclusively, and that it is upsetting they aren’t finished yet. We also feel this way. We have been working on getting them moving again and hope to renew them and their designs so they can come out sooner than later.


:stars: OTHER THINGS TO KNOW!
Among all the development work we’ll be doing, we’re gonna be doing a lot of clean-up and stuff behind the scenes!

We will be updating our store pages, organizing our Trello, creating a more clear and concise roadmap, re-organizing our priorities, taking in feedback, and listening to your comments and helpful feedback on the surveys.


:stars: FINAL THOUGHTS & PERSPECTIVE
Mac came up with the dream of GMod Tower in 2006 when he was in high school, and it’s been 18 years of work on this passion project. Everyone on the team and who has been on the team in the past has had passion for the game, gaming, or their part in the project.

We just want you guys to know that Tower is supposed to be a dream game. It’s a game we on the team want to play and have wanted to exist. It means a lot to us and is shaped by our experiences and love of gaming in general.

We have always been humbled by how much love and appreciation Tower has gotten and that Tower has found a place in many people’s hearts. Working on Tower for these years has been a dream come true. We’ve all gone through life changing events and formed memories that will last a lifetime thanks to Tower. We are so thankful for a supportive community and for those who have enjoyed Tower and shared with us their memories and happiness.

We just wanted to say thank you again to all of you once again, and for any feedback and support of Tower Unite throughout the years, and we can’t wait to keep working on this project with you all!

We want to discuss the history of Tower’s development in the future, and talk to you guys more informally about it when we have the time.

~ wheezwer
<3 PixelTail Games

notes.content:

HALLOWEEN 2024 EVENTS ARE HERE!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/d9519ae815798fd22fd24b8c12c983173ce14486.png
Our Halloween events have begun!  Enjoy the Halloween festivities and fun as well as some new items that can be found at the Ghoulcery at the center fountain!

Ghoul Coins
