New: Player Profile Backgrounds
New ways to customize yourself have been added - profile backgrounds!

These profile backgrounds decorate your scoreboard profile throughout the game. This Halloween, we have exclusive Halloween only profile backgrounds. We plan to add more non-Halloween profile backgrounds in the future!

To equip your profile backgrounds, go to Appearance > Profile > Scoreboard > Background.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/482ca0fccdcd18487ebd5b55d4cbfcdb8f6f711f.png

Hot Bar Improvements
Hot bar had some improvements with a new feature that allows you to toggle weapons and potions. You can toggle holster your weapon by pressing the corresponding key on the hot bar for your equipped weapons, and you can toggle size potion effects on your potions as well!

Pluck-A-Pal Rework
Pluck-a-Pal was completely redone. The game is now 100% physics driven and the plushies no longer are inside capsules, which brings a more authentic crane game experience. We also fixed many, many bugs with it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1df398d8b96d9c207d45fae2cd3d26dc14553c9f.png

Billiards Fixes
Billiards now has improved physics for pocketing, and lots of fixes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/02eec3f42d9e81c2f688e00c5d75456fcbc06c77.png

Condo: Media Volumes
A new Condo builder feature - one that has been requested many times is now available! Media Volume is a new IO Volume that builders can use to automatically toggle on Mediaplayers when players are within the volume. You can set these volumes up by connecting a Mediaplayer to the Media Volume with the Tower Glove.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/302ae4c1b760e67f69c8240318fce0797e4f74b9.png


Condo: Mature Only Filter
In an effort to provide a safer environment for our players, we have added a Mature Only condo filter feature.

By default, condos that have certain words/tags in their title will be tagged as mature. They will be hidden by default.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/b83f18ad109276c510db4b253271546d07dc52b9.png


When enabled, they will have a Mature Tag assigned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a4d939a44ff775e1df3bfde7bde4e4d742844327.png

When you go to host your condo, there's a new tag button to enable the Mature Content tag, which appends "18+" to the condo title.

Please be advised, if you host your Condo with mature content without applying the tag, you may be subject to moderation actions. Please use the mature content tags appropriately. Some keywords that will mark your condo as Mature Only are: 18+, NSFW, 21+, Mature. We also have a built-in list of keywords that will automatically mark your Condo, these keywords will be expanded in further updates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/43dae511c2e7847a4c6e4d857b11cf30ed7b5812.png



Condo: Remove From Group
We’ve added the ability to more easily remove objects from groups! This allows you to remove single items from your group without having to break the entire group apart.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1237824c1aefa16bef2249d9e66ef7b08ef0181e.png

This update addresses several issues such as Arcade, Ball Race and Zombie Massacre custom level issues, static item SDK importing, and several map issues.

Ball Race Custom Map Fixes

In this update, we addressed several de-sync issues with custom maps in Ball Race multiplayer. The changes should resolve the majority of multiplayer related issues for custom maps.

notes.title: Content Creator Update! (0.18.1.0)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/ae9bbb02e6d1db37f1bf5928315eaa2a42ba9257.png


Ball Race Map Maker!
The Ball Race Map Maker is now available! Play with tons of tools and options to make your very own Ball Race maps! With tools for obstacles, course creation options, and a world of possibilities with the Editor system, you can make the map of your dreams!

The new map maker includes built-in Ball Race music support, leaderboard support (when unit approved), and more level design and editing features.

Ball Race itself also received various improvements.

You can get started making your own Ball Race maps by heading to the guide here: https://towerunite.com/guides/wk_ballrace.html


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/3e3023b9c0262c2e4a89eb1394db0facef08b24c.jpg



Zombie Massacre Map Maker!
The Zombie Massacre Map Maker is also now available! This map maker includes features such as customizable escapes, sub-objectives, and plenty of options for making the ultimate standoff against the zombie hordes!

With this update, Zombie Massacre has new gameplay elements exclusively for Map Makers (and for official maps very soon): sub-objectives, keycards, and custom escapes.

Zombie Massacre itself also received various improvements, including a new boss!

You can get started making your own Zombie Massacre maps by heading to the guide here: https://towerunite.com/guides/wk_zombiemassacre.html


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/79e40266bdeb0fffe2897367e21e41503d83f4af.jpg


ZM: New Boss - T-Rex!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/37763a783bd38f42f491f8fe4477d30614444703.jpg

The king of Dinosaurs, resurrected! He’s locked and loaded with missiles and dual wielding miniguns. Field raptors are deployed to assist alongside. Face off against this intimidating boss as you fight to survive your final night!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/633b7586422ac27782dd8a1c98fd82d00092a869.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/ac950d3187a13e981c31c16655fa5fe92df3e715.jpg


New Workshop Player Model Rig/SDK!
The 3.0 Workshop Player Model Rig is now implemented! This rig offers more fluid animations, IKs, and easier options for modifying proportions of a model, and massive improvements to the process of rigging player models. This has been a lot of work!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/030e7037330507c01044335caad30dab7950c102.gif

We have made a new guide for workshop creators to get started here: https://towerunite.com/guides/wk_creatingcharacters_v3.html


We’ve retargeted the old rig to work with the new rig (and existing player models) without any changes needed. That means that legacy Workshop player models will be compatible immediately. The animations have all been overhauled and improved in many ways.

Workshop creators will be required to use this new SDK to create player models. Existing models can be updated by following the guide.



Co-op Condo Fixes
Co-op Condos have received some much-needed love in this update! We’ve made fixes for Canvas editing issues, NPC/dialogue editing issues, IO timer and Damage Volume editing issues for those who try to edit the hosts Condo!

Fall 2024 Plaza Update
This update includes some changes to the Plaza as well! The Bowling Alley and Laser Tag buildings have had an art pass that includes new entryway details and layout as well as a new “party room” for the Bowling alley, a little reminder of Lobby 2! There were also various fixes to holes and seams around the Plaza, quality of life tweaks, and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/f3280f6ffeb97752dc5da053037d75c5da38b18e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/e7751a4bd2e8723b7752a3ecc2b46430965720cc.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a7e0979bd2b1dd1317f21bcead898b1372cc7b30.jpg

Quality of Life Changes
There have been many changes to improve the quality of gameplay in general, so here are those areas that included changes:


 Plaza - various Plaza changes, optimizations, restart notification is more noticeable, removed a teleporter on the beach
 Minigames - combo time adjustment, weapon changes
 Game World Ports - fixes to scenery and collision, change to the height of screens for legibility
 Virus: Horde Mode - non-collision item avoidance, push/damage heal volume fixes, horde mode flame effects fixes, players no longer infect on touch in horde mode


General Bug Fixes

 Plaza - hole fixes, fixed duplicated media screens, z-fighting, lilypads, optimizations
 Minigolf: Collision Mutator - Emission fix, collision is now disabled when you pocket, HUD now shows when its active
 Minigolf Map Maker - fixes to water volume hazards, canvas images clearing on walls, par networking issues, cannon issues, 1x1-dipped missing textures, base height settings, non-global sky volumes, no OOB in tubes
 Virus - Catzek exploit fixes, horde AI spawning, horde movement & interaction fixes


VR Alpha
VR has had a lot of development as well! VR is still in alpha, but this update includes massive improvements to the VR experience, including a working VR menu and more VR interactions. 

We're still heavily developing VR, so there will be issues such as the camera not positioning properly. You can fix the VR camera by pressing R on your keyboard, but this will not be a requirement in later updates.


 VR Menus - the menu now draws through the 3D world and no longer gets blocked by objects, new floating HUD for VR to allow toggling voice, menu for Plazas now shows all active Plazas
 VR Interactions - basic pickup support (you can pickup and throw items, but it’s currently just tap), basic weapon support, basic libretro lightgun support, improved use beam
 VR Fixes - left hand trace no longer overrides right hand trace on menus, VR menu no longer displays a black screen, fixed loading menus not working well in VR
 VR Animations - hand IK is now setup and starting development



New Items
Various new items are also now available! 

These include various destructible scenery items like crates, pots, and explosive barrels; the Physics-al Media Shelf to store media and Libretro cartridges; mirrors; new nature items like lily pads and variations of the Ceiba tree seen in Catzek; and the 3D text item, to make more diverse floating signs and notes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/0ab474ec18a815445c7c8dc020f5b160fd69af46.jpg

Mirrors
Reflect on your reflection! The new mirror item reflects the world and players, and uses the mirror settings in graphics settings. You can toggle the mirror on/off by using it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/08a6cf4a9893e948213d87e2aa0b462c958615cf.jpg


Media Shelves
These new media shelf items will let you organize and store Physical Media and Libretro cartridges on a shelf! Just toss a physical media at a shelf to shelf it! You can also place down a Media Shelf Volume from the IO section of the Condo Inventory to create your own custom shelves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/6b27bb87a0aebef917e63dff20c1381e566b2be2.gif


Tons of Bug Fixes and Improvements!
We've been addressing a lot of the reported bugs and there's a ton of fixes, optimizations in this update that range from Plaza, Game Worlds, Map Makers, VR, Condos, and Co-op Condos.

Upcoming Halloween Events
Halloween is right around the corner, so keep an eye out for the usual events, ghoul coins, and some new items next month!

Hello everyone and welcome to this week’s Tower Unite Dev Log!

notes.title: Weekly Dev Log for September 3rd, 2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the Weekly Dev Log for September 3rd, 2024, detailing all the changes that have happened since August 26th, 2024. Note: Devs that don't appear in the weekly log are not necessarily away or not doing work, but may be working on things currently not announced or backend work that doesn't need to be detailed.

Zombie Massacre: Map Maker

macdguy worked on some new features for the Zombie Massacre Map Maker.

ZM Map Maker: Keycards

Keycards are new Zombie Massacre pickups that come in 4 different types (red, blue, green, yellow). You can place these in your levels to use as a form of door currency to unlock specific doors with the specific keycard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1e5bbb778303386840e4582d04f9e84d60167449.png

The new keycard system comes with two items, the keycard pickup and the redeem volume that accepts the matching keycard. The keycards and the redeem volume can be use once only and come with a reset IO function as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/e7c859863e281a163f7c688b9182040ee7d14d0f.jpg

When a player picks up a keycard, the entire team can use the keycard for matching doors.

[previewyoutube=zl8ZR1LFAMo;full][/previewyoutube]

It's very easy to setup the redeem volume.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/4c7453da0152ee5b459921e28294100bdf1e7203.jpg

A player can hold as many keycards as desired.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/96cac152c25d665cc41b456386e0a775cc83cc7f.png

ZM Map Maker: Game Controller Module

This IO module will let you control certain ZM game elements such as the day timer and zombie spawners.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/bea5406e9d75f6f02feb46f39ae5aef2b0b34945.png

ZM Map Maker: Boss Selection

You can now select which boss you want to spawn for your map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/ac3871f5c6732ce1c2892ccfa9210001735c7775.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/b54ad163fc9ecf3303bd190ab260de9615b41000.png

Minigolf: Map Maker

macdguy worked on some improvements to the Minigolf Map Maker.

The Loop Piece now has base height / flat base support. Custom textures applied will no longer stretch when the base height is adjusted, like the built in surfaces.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/904def00a070a66ba5175942c5a7120364857387.jpg

Pluck-a-Pal Rewrite

macdguy worked on a overall rewrite of Pluck-a-Pal. 

The crane and prongs are all now physics based which will help fix the majority of the issues with the game. The previous version was half physics which led to the crane clipping into physics and causing weird issues.

[previewyoutube=6NIbRFF7K9g;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: August 2024 Dev Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/725044c7b2d20b8d06a6343eefc298aa8d28f5c5.png

Hey everyone! We’re back again for the August Dev Update!

Upcoming Developments Survey
With the Minigolf Map Maker out, we’re moving on to the other projects we’ve discussed with you in previous dev updates!

We’re currently looking for some feedback on the direction for development!

TU Future Interest Survey:
Give your feedback in this survey!

Dev Livestream
We are planning on doing a livestream soon to show a little bit more about how you can use the Map Makers and to show off some VR development!

It’ll be a casual stream, and we’ve been talking about doing more of these as we haven’t done any in some time.

Please let us know anything specific you all would be interested in seeing shown off on stream!

Future Plush Interest Form
We’re holding a survey to gauge peoples’ interest in our next campaign with Makeship! You can give feedback here.

VR Support
Since the last dev update, progress was made on loading screens, error popups, Condo Hosting Menu, Condo Workshop Browser Menu, Plaza join, and Condo join in VR!

Ball Race Map Maker
Ball Race map maker development is complete, has a guide, and will be ready for the next update! All of the pieces necessary for creating Ball Race maps are complete and we’re excited to see what you all make when it comes out!

Zombie Massacre Map Maker
The Zombie Massacre map maker is near complete as well, it just needs to be tested! AI navigation, helipads, spawn points, camera tools, and more were all completed!

Game Types & Mutators
The mutator system is finished as of the last update, so we are planning on implementing more mutators in future updates! We have a forum thread if you have a suggestion for a new Mutator or Game Type here: Game Type Suggestion Thread

SDNL Announcer
More SDNL voice lines have been hooked up in game and attached to events! We just need to make a new intro sequence for SDNL to complete the announcer.

Community / Dedicated Condos
We have been hosting our own dedicated Condo for a while and are working on getting dedicated condos to be part of the server lister!

The next step is ensuring Workshop will function properly.

Workshop Rig 3.0
We made a lot of progress with the new Workshop rig. We’re getting the rig to import right now. The import process is nearly done, and we’re resolving a few small issues. It’s intended to come out with the next update.

Virus: Theme Park
Lots of progress was made with Theme Park! We’ve made the sign for the candy area, finished art for teacups ride and the candy seating area. There was progress with the ice cream truck model, an art pass on jungle area, bathroom and souvenir buildings and paths, an art pass of curbs and floor details, an art pass on the arcade building, a large art pass on the carnival area, which added more stalls and games. We added more playable space in the bumper cars arena, started on the circus area, and, finally, did an art pass on the castle area.

Minigolf: Dino Drive
In the world of Dino Drive, preliminary designs have been made for every hole, laid out in their positions, and the art phase has begun (including the new tiki items)! Dino Drive is meant to be reminiscent of a Minigolf course one would see at a small theme park, and has a tacky dinosaur theme with painted cardboard cutouts and mechanical moving parts. The first half and second half of the holes are divided in theme, the second half will be interior and the first half will be exterior.

New Arcade Phase: Early Stages
For the upcoming Arcade update, we wanted to mention once again that Air Hockey and the indoor shooting gallery are confirmed as new additions with this phase! Art work has not begun but will start soon.

August Calendar!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/5d4f197f95b68637f3cfc65787ff1f3c4f246ab4.png

Here is the Tower Unite calendar for August! If you’d like to give feedback on bonus events, please do so here!
That’s all for this dev update! Thanks so much for reading.

notes.title: Minigolf Map Maker (0.18.0.0)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/903d4b5733dcc6447e4ffe95de33a3d7dca8b5a4.png

[previewyoutube=1G6kjn434sg;full][/previewyoutube]

Minigolf Map Maker
Hold on to your putters, because the Minigolf Map Maker is here!!! 

TU players can now create their own functional Minigolf maps using the map maker!

You can use custom workshop models, workshop sounds, canvases, movers and more to make your Minigolf map!

To get started, we made a guide here: https://towerunite.com/guides/wk_minigolf.html

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/3e3340e7a9e5cd07c581f5c82cd8f51477d8464f.gif

You can find the Minigolf Map Maker tools with the rest of the Game World creation tools in the Condo I/O inventory tab.

We spent a lot of time creating unique course pieces with tons of variations which can be snapped together using the grid snap tool! Simply place your pieces, adjust their settings, place down a hole and start pad, and play! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/fc95d9087020490362e8cab7af26ce48567ada8a.gif

You can utilize camera tools, pipes, launchers, cannons, out of bounds volumes, and so much more to create awesome courses, and upload them to the Steam Workshop so other players can join the fun!

There will also be the opportunity for community maps to be approved for unit payouts, so players can get rewarded for their skills like they would when playing a standard Minigolf map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/79ebb1968bc12713b6259ae0fb1fa701d0427021.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1e702be31630b919ef05f7469d6f3304025626ae.jpg

Plaza: New Transit Station!
The transit station has been completely revamped, redesigned, and fully optimized. This new station offers a more exciting spawn point for the Plaza and runs better than the previous one! Fans of Lobby 2 will enjoy our callbacks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/61c72dfe583b86e669139bcd88bfd04a238956e6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/40539bc618fc3532815a95fd96fb5ccfb57dd004.png

Plaza Optimizations - Less Hitches!
We have been working hard on optimization for the Plaza and have greatly reduced hitching in the Plaza!


New Game World Map Select
Starting a game world is now easier than ever, along with improved support for custom game world maps.

When going to the Game Worlds tab on the menu menu, and selecting a game world of your choice, you will now see thumbnails of the available maps and custom maps.

Installing custom maps has also been improved and is now quicker to get into.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/899a8406e1f467f523ebaca8f1cea8848603810b.png

Virus: Horde Mode - New PVE Gametype
Tired of sitting around and waiting for the infection to spread? In Horde mode, it’s already here!

Horde mode is a new PVE gametype for Virus, where you must fend off the infected until the time runs out!

You can now join Virus matches in single player and fend off the horde of infected!

You can play horde mode with friends as well, but it only requires one player to begin!

Horde Mode is also supported in user created maps!


SDNL Mutators & Player Outlines
Mutators are game settings that can be applied by the game host that customizes gameplay.

Mutators have been added to SDNL to allow for more customized matches that suit lobby sizes and play preferences!

Also, we have added player outlines to non-team game types for better visibility.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/f8b7572f5c8e36c295ed3c7585901d30a1b44ca1.jpg

Minigolf: Player Collision Mutator
We’ve added Minigolf: Collision mode for you all to play around with. This mutator allows balls to collide, allowing for wacky antics galore. Keep in mind, when this mutator is enabled, HIO achievements are disabled along with leaderboards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/81418557fbec2e7805f4b42331ba9f329c657652.png


Camera I/O - Create your own cutscenes in your Condo!
There are new Camera Volume and Camera IO items that can be accessed through the IO tab! Use these items to make walking through your Condo more dramatic and cinematic, or create cutscenes for your stories! There are tons of ways these tools can be messed around with to add to the Condo-building possibilities, so mess around with them today!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/94c4f788c9be93df47b9511ad1bdc93848d0208b.gif

We made a guide to get you started on how to use the new Camera tool: https://towerunite.com/guides/condo_camera.html


Condo: Live Surface Previewing
The condo material editor has been improved. Now when you hover over a material for your walls, it'll preview what it'll look like immediately, allowing you to make better decisions on if it works for your condo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/4b52966106b694b3d9751b37df3bfc936db0e0de.gif

New Guide Website
We have created a new guide website that covers a range of helpful information about the game, common support issues, how to play, and how to use the new condo tools and map creation tools.

Check it out here:
https://towerunite.com/guides/intro.html


New Tiki Furniture Set
In anticipation for the new Dino Drive Minigolf map we're working on, we have a new Tiki furniture set for you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/245ea5244617e5fcf037d56e4ae6e5149d53041a.png


VR Alpha Menu
We’re really excited to get to share more VR functionality with you all! If you’ve been keeping up with our monthly Dev Updates, you’ll know we recently had a breakthrough in our VR development and have been able to get back to work on it.

VR is not fully functional still, but there is much better menu functionality than there was before. It is still very much in alpha, but there is now a new menu you can interact with and join the Plaza, your Condo, and other player Condos. Keep in mind that VR is not finished, so while you can interact with some items such as doors, things like picking up items does not work and using games will lock you. VR is view only right now. We currently recommend using a gamepad to navigate the VR world if you intend on playing games while in VR. Game Worlds are currently not supported.

To access this new menu, press one of the right buttons on your right motion controller. You can then interact using the right trigger.



Changes
 New Transit Station!
 Minigolf Map Maker
 Virus: Added a new game type - Horde Mode! Horde Mode is a singleplayer/co-op gametype where infected zombies attack. Players must fend them off until the time runs out. Horde mode is compatible with custom levels
 Minigolf: Added new mutator - Players Collide. When this mutator is enabled, golf balls will collide with each other. HIO Achievements are disabled while this mode is enabled
 Game Ports: The Plaza is now visible in the background, giving a more immersive feel
 Added Plaza restart chat notifications when the Plaza is about to restart for daily maintenance
 Sped up workshop map browser
 New map select: Now displays maps as thumbnails instead of a list. Top voted custom levels also now show up automatically in the map select
 Added Random option when starting a new map to the map select screen
 Laser Tag: Reduced rounds from 3 rounds to 2
 You can now set a custom thumbnail for your Condos/Maps
Added controller support to Fishing

New Items
 Added Tiki Torch, Tiki Bar, Modular Bamboo, Tiki Armchair, Tiki Sofa, Tiki Dining Chair, Tiki Dining Table, Tiki Coffee Table, Tiki Accent Table, Tiki Shelf, Outdoor Cushion to Seasons/Celebrations/Oasis stores
 Added Bag of Chips to Fresh/Vendy/Boardwalk Snackbar stores
 Added Barrel (Physics), Green Goo (Physics) to Rob's Imports store
 Added Camera Volume, Camera IO, and Minigolf SDK items to Condo IO inventory

Misc Changes Clicking on Play on a workshop level will now check if the map is downloaded, download automatically, then start play after it was finished downloading (instead of having download then having to click on play after)
 Added up vote count display on workshop level thumbnails when browsing workshop maps
 Added visual feedback when the host is downloading a custom workshop level
 Added visual feedback when the custom levels in the votemap screen are being searched for
 Reduced amount of clicks needs to start a new game - you just need to click on a map to host a server
 UI: Reduced visual clutter on workshop vote maps
 UI: Removed glow effect from current events image to reduce visual clutter
 Added controller support to Game World map selection menus


Condo IO Changes Condo IO: Added != to Logic Gate Equals
 Condo IO: Added "Lock", "Unlock" IO inputs to Relay Module, allowing you to lock relays from being fired when in this locked state
 Added Camera Volume IO item, which allows players to override player cameras while inside the volume, used with Camera IO. Can be used for level editors such as Minigolf
 Added Camera IO item, which is a placeable camera (hidden from view) that can set the player's view. The camera has features for following the player, FOV, aspect ratio, zooming (IO input), setting the camera for individual players, and setting the camera for all players (for cutscenes)
 Added Physics Spawner IO item, which is a new IO item that can spawn physics items when used with IO. Can be used for level editors

Condo Changes Condo/SDK: Added Live Surface Previewing - when highlighting over surfaces it'll update the in-game surface as a preview so you can decide on surfaces easier
 Condo/SDK: Surface thumbnails now animate for surfaces that have animations (such as fire)
 Condo/SDK: Added Heat Wave condo surface material

SDK Changes SDK - Little Crusaders: Birb now moves around in custom levels! Birb AI pathing now works automatically

Game World Changes SDNL: Added player outlines for better visibility on non-team games
 SDNL: Reduced kills to end round from 30 to 10
 SDNL: Added mutators per game type (low grav, 1 HP mode, longer rounds)
 SDNL: Sliding will now slide you towards the direction you first started the slide in
 SDNL: Sliding will uncrouch you after sliding
 SDNL: Sliding now has a slight cooldown

Bug Fixes Plaza optimizations and hitching fix
 Fixed canvas cache system not working properly
 Fixed High Quality Shaders setting not working
 Fixed several issues where Game World hosts could not download custom levels and votemap would get stuck waiting
 Fixed several issues where game world ports would not download custom levels / start custom levels
 Fixed co-op condo clients timing out when using slider settings
 Fixed a crash with IO and movers (specifically with stop/start events)
 Fixed first person camera being broken after leaving RC items (such as RC minigolf ball, RC dragon)
 Fixed workshop pending download count not showing up
 Fixed performance issues with Logic Gate Equals IO
 Fixed workshop map titles not showing up on waiting for players menu
 Fixed up an absurd amount of player wearable offsets
 Fixed pool tube animations not looping
 Fixed Noise Makers Volume and Sound Emitter Volume settings not restoring from save data
 Fixed voice chat volume slider closing the scoreboard when you interact with it
 Fixed canvas URL data not being saved if you set the URL then click on a different canvas tab
 Fixed not being able to use camera controls (mouse wheel) after using a Hidden Seat that has a non-default pose set
 Fixed pending workshop sound packs not displaying as if a sound pack is being downloaded
 Fixed Teleport Volume not teleporting Ball Race orbs or Minigolf balls
 SDK: Fixed LC round end music not being muted when the Game World Music manager has music muted
 Fixed hair not hiding (for hats that hide hair) if you have multiple wearables and also not unhiding hair when removing wearables
 Fixed Vault item render scale causing it to pop out when open
 Fixed up vote count not updating correctly when previewing different maps in the map workshop browser
 Fixed relax pose for NPCs
 UI: Fixed padding issues with map select in 720p mode
 UI: Fixed long map titles going off the map icon section
 Fixed Project 12 NPC dialogue clipping through media player
 Fixed Workshop Sound Emitters not playing when leaving their range unless you are very close to them
 Fixed pending workshop downloads not displaying when on a custom game world level
 Fixed RC Golf Ball not working with Trigger/Teleport Volumes
 Fixed vehicles not teleporting properly with teleporters

Right now, we focused on porting and updating existing guides, as well as creating the Minigolf Map Maker guide, but we want to also cover some more simpler guides, like how to get started when first decorating your condo, and some gameplay guides on each game world. 

There are videos and image examples included in most guides. We'll be updating the in-game help menu to open the guide website as well. The Minigolf Map Maker guide is on here if you want to get a preview of it before the map maker update comes out.

We're nearing completion on getting the Minigolf Map Maker out the door, and into all of your hands. We're super excited to see what maps the community is able to create with these tools.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1e702be31630b919ef05f7469d6f3304025626ae.jpg

Minigolf Map Maker: Camera Editor

All of the hard work of getting splines working and the camera system culminated in the Minigolf Intro Camera tool. This allows you as the map maker to make custom camera intros for each hole. If one isn't place, it'll default to a static camera.

notes.title: July 2024 Dev Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/418a285575a3c9bbef7d67820f1b47506e29d7e8.png

Hello everyone! We’re back for the July Dev Update!

Funding/ Makeship Campaigns
Hey everyone, we’re here again for our Monthly Dev Update! This is a big one!
First off, since you guys are awesome and funded our previous campaigns, we were able to start two Makeship campaigns on June 28th!

This time the campaigns are for a 3-pack of pins and a Kalleira (+ Cosmic Catsack) plushie. You can order them in a bundle, so you can save, if you want to do that!

The campaigns will be running for a limited time, so be sure to keep an eye on them if you want to snag them for yourself!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a78219f9bb4d00a244832669fa79ac5730678449.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/b1a1ea20e938d6f8c6e8891472e060ada03860a9.png

Buying this merch seriously helps us with funding TU’s development, and we can’t thank you enough for supporting us in any way you have already.

Also, to those of you who bought the Cornelius Plush: keep an eye out! Those should be shipping out later this month!

Updates Overview
So far this year we released: Minigolf: Nostalgia & Workshop Map SDK (For Virus, SDNL, and LC)
 The Supporter Pack
 Minigolf: Haven
 The Engine Upgrade and Movers Update
 Anniversary Events
 Bumper Cars
 Workshop Sound Packs / The Big Summer Update
 Ball Race: Eruption
The updates next in line are: Minigolf / Ball Race Map Editors
 Plaza Optimizations
 Dedicated Condos
 Workshop Rig 3.0
Other updates we’re planning are:
 Arcade Update
 SDNL Update (Voice Lines, Map Updates, etc.)
 New Minigolf Map


JUNE PROGRESS

Minigolf Map Editor
The Minigolf map editor is planned to be the next update now that Eruption is out! During June, progress was made on the Base Height Settings and S-Bend tool. These are tools that will help with the shape and style of courses players make.

Features still in progress include the Ramp tool and the Holes tool. For the Ramp tool, progress has been made on Steepness settings and Ramp Type variations. We’re still working on Curve Tightness settings, the Flat Base setting, Base Height setting , Wall Variations, and Wall Height settings. For the Holes tool, we’ve been working on the Hole Type setting and the Dip setting.

Ball Race Map Editor
Lots of progress has been made on the Ball Race map editor! We’ve completed options to hide Bumpers and Trampolines, we’ve made a spline mesh for platforms, and we’ve finished making Start Tubes, Arrows, Spikes, Buttons, and a tool to test the ball. We’ve added Tubes, a Ball Launcher, Drums, Gongs, and Boost Volumes as well.

Plaza Optimizations
In the mean time, progress was made on Plaza Optimizations. We’ve finished up work on the art pass and optimization of the Transit Station and have moved on to optimizing stores (and doing some art improvements)!

These optimizations will not only help with performance inside these locations, but they will also help with performance in the surrounding areas in the Plaza, so we’re excited to get them all out to you.

These changes will be included in an upcoming update.

Moderation Tools
We’ve implemented a new ban appeals system which will greatly streamline ban appeals.

In short, you will now use this ticket system for appealing bans and will no longer appeal bans through our email.

This will allow for easier resolutions of appeals as well as informing appealing users of the status of their appeal in a more timely fashion.

For more info on how to appeal bans now, visit the How to Appeal Bans.



Future Updates
After the Minigolf and Ball Race SDK are out, we plan to release an update for Dedicated Condos, the Workshop 3.0 Rig, SDNL, and some more new maps!

Workshop Rig 3.0 Preparations
In regard to Workshop Rig 3.0, right now we are preparing the SDK Importer and creating a tutorial for the rig. Once that’s done, we’ll release another update where this new rig will be usable.

SDNL Update
In June, progress has been made on the SDNL update we’ve mentioned this year.

We’ve been organizing and implementing the Announcer voice lines that were recorded last summer by the voice actor Gianni Matragrano, along with getting work done on some additional sound effects!

If you don’t remember, the SDNL update will include Announcer voice lines as well as changes to Container Ship and the release of SDNL: Lookout. Lookout is a rework of Zombie Massacre: Acrophobia for SDNL, giving you an opportunity to see that map from a whole new perspective!

Dedicated Condos
Due to Canvas and Workshop issues, there hasn’t been more progress on Dedicated Condos this month, but it’s still in the plan. We should be able to get to work on this in full swing in the coming months, so keep an eye out for updates.

We have also had some discussions this month on how to better advertise Dedicated Condos so more people can understand the concept by giving it a flashier name. Community Worlds was one we came up with, and we’re still brainstorming others.

For reference, our current progress on Dedicated Condos can be viewed here.

Arcade Update
We love the Arcade as much as you all do, and we’re always itching to get back to it. We have a fun Arcade update planned for the future that will bring in some new games. We’ll be getting to work on this very soon. Like Dedicated Condos, just keep an eye out for this in the future.

Map Work
In the world of Game World maps, progress has been made on a new Minigolf map! We aren’t ready to dive into the details of it yet, but know that more than half the holes have been completed!

VR Support
We also wanted to share that we recently had a breakthrough with getting motion controllers working again! With that issue out of the way, work can continue on VR Support.

July Calendar
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/69c75f1dfefe1987b533e28d4b16157aa5dd4e77.png

Here is the calendar for July events! If you want notifications, we have the events set up on our Discord here. If you would like to make a suggestion for events, do so here.
That’s gonna do it for this Dev Update! Thanks for reading, and we’ll see you next time.

notes.title: Workshop Sound Packs - The Big Summer Update! (0.17.12.0)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/65117ff39272abad13e389376e1f28c8aa35fc64.jpg

Workshop Sound Packs
Workshop Sound Packs are here! Now players can upload custom sound packs to the Workshop to use in their Condos and SDK Maps.

Sound Packs are a collection of sound files that can be placed in your Condo and shared with others. A tutorial on how to get started can be found here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3266039265

We also added a bunch of new sound features:

 Playlists - play multiple sounds in an order
 Sound Volume - a new volume that handles playback of sound emitters (clientside) based on if you are inside the volume or not. Has options to mute outside sounds as well
 Game World Music Manager - override gameplay music for your custom levels
 New IO inputs: "SetSound", "SetPlaylistID", "FadeToPitch", Fade duration




New Emote Menu!
We’ve jazzed up the emote menu with some custom icons and a larger UI! You can now set up emotes on your keyboard shortcuts for easy access!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/98692735227e02cec1853eef583e13eced1394a1.png

Arcade Optimizations
This update includes Arcade physics server optimizations, which have been in progress for a few months now! They were tough to work on due to the many unique physics for each Arcade game, as well as a major cleanup of the code. What this means for players is that we’ve improved the networking and reduced the amount of work the simulation has to do so it’ll execute it faster - putting less strain on the Plaza servers.


Item and Inventory Changes
You can now see quick results as you type in the inventory search bar. This will allow you to get to your intended items quicker and to have a better view of your inventory as a whole.

Internally, we also optimized how items are queried in the system to make improvements to the inventory UI and you’ll see an FPS boost for large inventories.


Workshop Linux & Steam Deck Fixes
We’ve fixed the issue with Workshop Models not appearing on Linux machines. The change required us to rework how Workshop models are installed, and, with the added sound packs, the pipeline had to be gutted and refitted. We’re very happy that Workshop will be working again for Linux & Steam Deck.


Workshop Rig 3.0 & Animations: Phase 1
This update introduces phase 1 of the new Workshop rig! This new rig allows for more fluid animation of player models, IKs, modifying proportions of a model, and massive improvements to the process of rigging player models. We’ve retargeted the old rig to work with the new rig (and existing player models) without any changes needed. That means that legacy Workshop player models are compatible immediately. All the animations have all been overhauled and improved in many ways.

This change was extremely challenging, so we are going to be doing this in phases. This first phase is just implementing the new rig into the game and updating all the animations for it, while also starting to implement IK features for Arcade games (such as on Wheel of Fire).

We are currently getting the importer SDK updated with the 3.0 rig. In phase 2, you will be able to use it for importing your own player models. We are also creating a new updated guide.


New Accessibility Options
As we mentioned in our May Dev Update, we’ve been working on organizing our backlog of bug reports, crashes, and other game issues, and accessibility suggestions have been a part of that! We’ve been able to get a better overview of these suggestions and get a good chunk of them in the game in this update.

All of the accessibility changes in this update were suggested by players. These include various changes to improve general visual and audio experience, changes to reduce eye strain and nausea, changes to controls for easier interactions, and improvements to existing accessibility settings, among other changes. Plaza Minigames, Arcade, Minigolf, Drunk Effects, Condos, Stores, Controls, and other parts of the game all had accessibility changes, so be sure to check out what’s new in the change log below.

And, if you have an accessibility related suggestion or feedback to improve any existing accessibility options, please drop a post in our Accessibility Related Suggestions Megathread: https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/accessibility-related-suggestions-megathread/40333


Condos
Canvas URL Replacer Tool
Big features in this update have had a connection to Condos, so other work has been done on our building tools as well. There are some accessibility additions such as a 3D grid visual and more editor options such as Noclip Speed Adjustment.

There’s also a new Replace Canvas URL tool and Find Canvas tool that will help out with quickly fixing dead image links in a Condo, as well as updating URLs quickly.

Changes have been made to the inventory system, grid snapping, organization, I/O options, and much more.

Condo Snapshot Improvements
And that’s not all! We also massively improved the time it takes to reset your Condo and load Condo snapshots. For builders, you’ll see immediate improvements to these systems.

Condo IO Updates
There’ve been quite a few updates to Condo I/O, but here's some of the highlights:

Volume Shapes
We’ve added Cylinder and Sphere shape types for Volumes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a50439c4b0601b0117e8f26bb2a83cf58cb682be.png

Logic Gates
Logic Gates are now working! AND, NOT, OR, XOR, Boolean Switch, and Compare are all available to help your IO logic

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/b468fbec68ff511c52cb6005973d7481da3613da.jpg

A new "Relay To All" module was added which lets you call inputs to all items connected to it at once, allowing you to set properties on multiple items with just 1 input

We also moved some items to be I/O items; Sound Emitter, Floating Text, Floating Dialogue, Hidden Seat, Aquarium Volume, and Sound Emitter are now I/O items (no unit cost).


Libretro
We’ve made some improvements to Libretro support, too. These improvements include automatically positioning the camera for Arcade cabinets (allowing for easier play with controllers) and Fullscreen support. Fullscreen also comes with lightgun and touchscreen support!

You can also disable automatic save states and we’ve added hot keys for save states (F3, F4 keys).


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a9ebe9acff60b61ac7c281512a307cea576091aa.png

Changes

 New Feature: Workshop Sound Packs!!
 New Player Emote menu! Emotes now have icons and you can bind hotkeys to each player emote. Hotkeys can be assigned by hovering over the emote and pressing the corresponding weapon key (1-9) and can be used by pressing C + the hotkey (ie. C+1, C+2, etc.)
 Added new player emotes: Wave (far), Wave (near), Peace, Clap

notes.title: Weekly Dev Log for June 11th, 2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the Weekly Dev Log for June 11th, 2024, detailing all the changes that have happened since June 3rd, 2024. Note: Devs that don't appear in the weekly log are not necessarily away or not doing work, but may be working on things currently not announced or backend work that doesn't need to be detailed.

May/June 2024 Condo Contest - RESULTS ARE IN

Hey everyone, voting is over and the results are in. There were 222 responses this time!

The winners are:

1st Place (2,000,000 Units) - Castle Garden by @GateTheCat
2nd Place (1,000,000 Units) - King Xanthos' Tourney by @Baby_In_A_Pipe 
3rd Place (750,000 Units) - Prometheus by @mexxorz
4th Place (500,000 Units) - MedievaLand! by @TheGreenKing 
5th place (300,000 Units) - Sketch Caverns by @ThurDoDinok

Everyone else will get 150,000 Units for their participation this time! Thanks again so much for participating in the contest and the vote. 

You can see all the submissions to this contest here, and stay tuned for future contests!

Improved Emotes Menu

We are hoping this will help give emotes more life and make them easier to use. The menu now has icons for each emote and bindable hot keys. To assign a hot key just hover over the emote and press the number key you want to bind it to. You can remove a keybind with delete key. To perform an emote shortcut use Context + the number key you bound (ie. C+1, C+3, etc.)

Improved Emotes Menu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/9643f40f7af4edd007b98d4cba241a120f778d65.png

Condo I/O

Relay to All

Tired of connecting 8 things and having to setup 8 different events to set their property (such as color)? With the new "Relay To All Module", you can wire multiple items to the module and the module will replicate all inputs to it to all the items it is connected to. It'll automatically populate the IO inputs available based on the items connected to it. Basically, tell the module to SetColor and it'll SetColor on all 8 buttons at once in one go.

notes.title: June 2024 Dev Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we’re here again for our Monthly Dev Update! This is a big one!

Update Progress
In the last dev update, we were wrapping up the Bumper Cars update, and we gave an overview of what we were working on, such as Minigolf & Ball Race SDK and other projects. Since then, our plans were to release an update with the new Workshop rig, Workshop sound packs, some Arcade optimizations, and accessibility changes.

However, this update’s been having some technical challenges that are both complicated to resolve and to complete. And, as you all probably know, we’re a small team, so it’s taken a lot of work to resolve these issues.

Basically, we’ve been having a very busy month, and this update is jam-packed with stuff, so let’s just get into what we have going on!

Reconstructing Core Code
So, sometimes when you fix something, something else breaks, or you find another issue or a flaw in the system. With many interconnected parts and a long development history, it’s easy for this to happen with Tower development. This has been happening a lot with this update. We’ve had to reorganize and refactor a lot this month. The issues have not been ones we can just let slide, either.

So, as you read through all of the following tasks we’ve been working on, know that it was probably juggled with fixing a frustrating regression. But we’ve been getting it done and working on ways to not cause these issues in the future.

Workshop Sound Packs
Workshop sound packs are a highlight of this update, adding the ability for players to upload custom sounds! We’ve also introduced new options for playlists, sound volumes, Game World Music override Manager, and “SetSound”, “Fade”, and general improvements to the sound emitter. You’ll be able to upload sound packs to Workshop, and we’ve made an easy to use editor in the Workshop editor for these. These tie into other I/O changes that will be explained more later on.

Workshop Fixes
A major issue we’ve been trying to resolve is a bug with Workshop models not appearing on Linux machines. This is notable as it affects Steam Deck users as well as any PC Linux users. Since work is being done on various areas of the Workshop, and this is a big issue, we have been tackling this and have resolved this issue after weeks of work. The change needed required us to rework how Workshop models are installed, and, with the added sound packs, the pipeline had to be gutted and refitted. We’re very happy that Workshop will be working again for Linux.

Workshop Rig 3.0 & Animations
Implementing the new Workshop rig has been an arduous task, but it’s been having great payoff. This new rig has allowed for more fluid animation of player models, IKs, and easier options for modifying proportions of a model, and massive improvements to the process of rigging player models. We’ve retargeted the old rig to work with the new rig (and existing player models) without any changes needed. That means that legacy Workshop player models will be compatible immediately. The animations have all be overhauled and improved in many ways.

We’ll have more information on the new SDK 3.0 very soon. But first, we’ll be releasing the updated animations and new rig support next update.

Accessibility Options
We’ve been hard at work implementing accessibility suggestions requested by players.

These include various changes to improve general visual and audio experience, changes to reduce eye strain and nausea, changes to controls for easier interactions, and improvements to existing accessibility settings, among other changes.

Plaza Minigames, Arcade, Minigolf, Drunk Effects, Condos, Stores, Controls, and other parts of the game all had accessibility changes, and you’ll get a full overview of the changes in the update change log (or on Trello).

Arcade Optimizations
Arcade physics server optimizations have been in progress for a few months now, and we’ve been working hard at getting the Arcade into a better state. These optimizations involve arcade physics which are a very finicky thing to work with due to the amount of machines that have unique physics to each game.

We had to refactor our code so the physics simulations would run as a system instead of independently on each machine. This required us to take the existing code and port the majority of it to C++. Server-side optimizations were made and a massive cleanup of the code was done. We improved the networking and reduced the amount of work the simulation has to do so it’ll execute it faster.

Item and Inventory Changes
We’ve made some updates to how items are categorized in the inventory. This has allowed for some previously hidden items to come out of the woodwork, as well as improving the search experience.

Speaking of searching, you can now see quick results as you type in the inventory search bar. This will allow you to get to your intended items quicker and to have a better view of your inventory as a whole.

Some items have been moved around to the appropriate stores or categories, and some items have had their names adjusted to better reflect their purpose.

Internally, we also optimized how items are queried in the system to make improvements to the inventory UI and you’ll see an FPS boost for large inventories.

Lastly, our item editor was bogging down development time and making it harder for us to continue to add new items. So, we improved our own item creation tools, which has already immensely helped us create items faster than before.

Condos / SDK
Big features in this update have had a connection to Condos, so other work has been done on our building tools as well. There are some accessibility additions such as a 3D grid visual and more editor options such as Noclip Speed Adjustment.

There’s also a new Replace Canvas URL tool and Find Canvas tool that will help out with quickly fixing dead image links in a Condo, as well as updating URLs quickly.

Changes have been made to the inventory system, grid snapping, organization, I/O options, and much more.

And that’s not all! We also massively improved the time it takes to reset your Condo and load Condo snapshots. For builders, you’ll see immediate improvements to these systems.

Condo I/O
There’ve been quite a few updates to Condo I/O, but some of the highlights are that we’ve added Cylinder and Sphere shape types for Volumes!

We also moved some items to be I/O items; Sound Emitter, Floating Text, Floating Dialogue, Hidden Seat, Aquarium Volume, and Sound Emitter are now I/O items (no unit cost).

Co-Op Condos
We’ve also implemented some fixes for bugs with co-op Condo building. These include fixes for Copycat, Connection Tool, and editing Notebooks. We also fixed drag-copy for I/O and grouped items.

Libretro
We’ve made some improvements to Libretro support, too. These improvements include automatically positioning the camera for Arcade cabinets (allowing for easier play with controllers) and Fullscreen support. Fullscreen also comes with lightgun and touchscreen support!

You can also disable automatic save states and we’ve added hot keys for save states (F3, F4 keys).

God, this update is inconceivable! When’s it coming out?!
We are in the late stages of testing the update! We are resolving more issues with the Arcade physics rewrite but the majority of the other features mentioned are ready to go! So, as soon as possible. We’re really working as hard as we can to get this out to you all.

Future Update Progress
In any downtime we’ve had while working on the next update, we’ve been making progress on various features that will be implemented in future updates.

These include:

Minigolf SDK Progress
A lot of exciting progress has been made on the Minigolf Map editor. We’ve set up the settings menu and customization options for course pieces. We’ve finished up work on the loop size setting, base settings, wall variation and height settings, corner shape and magnitude settings, fill settings, the corner tool, path-curve tool, ramp settings, the half-pipe tool, and intersection tool.

Additionally, there have been some updates to I/O for Minigolf. These include the course pieces being considered I/O items, an Out of Bounds Volume, In Bounds Volume, a Friction Override Volume, Boost Volume, and a Putt Zone Override Volume.

We also have made progress on Pipes, Cannons, Launchers, and Camera Volumes.

The testing tools have also been completed and you can quickly test Minigolf courses by interacting with the start pad and it’ll automatically put you into a golfball.

Ball Race SDK Progress
For Ball Race SDK, progress has been made on Finish Goals, Finish Volume, Attractors/Repulsors, Bumpers, Boost Volume, and of course Melon pickups.

The testing tools have also been completed and the editor now can run custom Ball Race maps.

We plan to roll out both the Minigolf SDK and Ball Race SDK out at the same time after the 0.17.12.0 update.

Transit Station Optimization and Art Pass
Along with Arcade Server Side Optimization, we’ve been working on optimizing the Plaza Train Station area as we found through profiling that it was impacting performance across the entire Plaza. Doing this required aggressive modeling work, which led to… a complete overhaul of the artwork of the transit station! Fans of Lobby 2 will be happy to know that the overhaul takes notes of the best parts of the transit station and the escalators actually work this time!

If you want to follow along with the update, check out the “Next Releases” section on our Trello.

June Calendar
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/ae622668619fdd4d8a89e9104577ac492e1d3073.png

Here is the Tower Unite calendar for June! If you’d like to give feedback on bonus events, please do so here!
That’s gonna do it for this Dev Update! Thanks for reading.

Note: Devs that don't appear in the weekly log are not necessarily away or not doing work, but may be working on things currently not announced or backend work that doesn't need to be detailed.

May/June 2024 Condo Contest

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1823cd4f1703bf2236646916ec325147a9854e17.png

Hey everyone, this time the contest is about custom Game World Maps!

Your entry can be for any of the Game Worlds that have Workshop Map SDK support (so Virus, SDNL, or Little Crusaders), and there's no time requirement for when the map was made!

Unlike previous contests, your entry must be uploaded to the Workshop and playable in TU! (We want maps to be judged on their gameplay and art!)

The submission period ends on June 6th, 2024 at 11:59 PM.

Be sure to look at the prizes and follow the rules here!

Minigolf SDK

The Minigolf SDK tools are nearing completion. The tool icons are now setup, along with the tools themselves and their settings.

All the different variants and selectable models for the Minigolf Editor makes for around 5,243 models. These models are all under the hood, as you tell the editor what the tile should be and it'll select the correct one for you.

Also, we did a lot of work both behind the scenes and in the editor UI to make working with the Minigolf tiles much easier, such as bug fixes and improvements to the grid snapping tools.

[previewyoutube=Qd7VuxkdJIc;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=VCbWo409kp4;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/cdef8725e032f53f1d3530733d5a1285afb87fb9.png

Canvas URL Replacer Tool

Easily replace URLs with new URLs across all canvas items that use the same URL in one click. Very useful to replace old/broken links.

There is also a new "Find" feature that will visually show all canvas items that are using the same URL so you can find where the canvas is in your Condo.

[previewyoutube=HOpwOUrvk2Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Sound Volumes

Sound Volumes are new IO volumes that handle playback of sound emitters (clientside) based on if you are inside the volume or not. 

Also comes with settings for fading sounds and muting outside sounds.

To use Sound Volumes you will have to click on "Collect" to collect all the sound emitters in the volume after placing the sound emitters inside the volume.

There will be a new IO module called Game World Music Manager. You can set custom music for each type of stage of the game world, if you don't set any sound it'll use the default game world music.

Workshop Game World Music Manager

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/f807ca79b0183340778bbbebc9b3e823b7297abc.png

Sound Playlists

We also added playlist support to sound emitters. While enabled, you can add multiple sounds that will play one after another and can be used for Workshop Sound Emitters

notes.title: May 2024 Dev Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/f460b488a7e3be913a81f3885057de4e135fe09c.png

Hey everyone, we’re back to talk about what we’ve been up to in April, what we’re going to get up to in May, and other topics!

May Events
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/b22bbff8b46e3fffcf4515fc5952b716a52661bb.png

We’ve got more fun events lined up for you all in May! Once again, be sure to let us know what events you want to see in the game. We really appreciate any input you all have on these. We’ve also made a thread to keep track of any suggestions you have here.

Makeship Campaign Over!
The Cornelius and Birb Makeship plush campaign was a success! You guys rock! We sold 726 plushes, and we are so grateful for everyone’s support with the campaign. They’re now being made, so if you bought a plush, keep an eye out for more info on shipping from Makeship in the coming months!

Keep an eye out for future merch collaborations with Makeship as well!

Bumper Cars Update
During April we were hard at work on the Bumper Cars update!

As Bumper Cars is a Plaza attraction, it was a tricky process to work on and test as we have to work on the large main Plaza level. Working on that level can often bring about issues with lighting and other parts of the game that are inter-connected, but Bumper Cars is finally released!

We’re so glad it’s finally out to you all, and its been awesome to see you all having fun with it. We also got a hot fix out to resolve any issues that popped up along the way.

What’s Next?
These are the big features on our minds post-Bumper Cars:  Minigolf SDK
 Ball Race SDK
 Workshop Sound Packs
 New Workshop Rig
 Transit Station Optimizations/Art Pass
 Arcade, SDNL, & Game World Maps

Minigolf SDK
We’re shifting our focus to completing the Minigolf SDK, which will allow players to create custom Minigolf maps! It’s an ambitious feature, but it’s going to be fun for you all and also help give us streamlined tools when making Minigolf maps in the future!

During April, progress has been made on various features of the Minigolf: SDK, such as:  curved ramp tool
 side shifter tool
 improvements and additional features for existing tools
 half pipe tool
 s-bend tool
We’re in the final stretch of creating all of the assets for the Minigolf editor, and just need to finish up some additional tools as well as setting it all up.

Like we’ve said before, these Minigolf tools require a lot more work than other Game World Map tools, and we have to balance what we’re working on between the different projects going on. But, we’re making a lot of progress with it!

Ball Race SDK
We are also working on getting the Ball Race SDK out, which comes with its own tools, such as a spline platform tool (Canvas Spline Mesh), custom music support (with ogg), and leaderboards for Workshop maps.

For leaderboards, we are planning a way to create staff-approved leaderboards for SDK maps which will work the same as our normal leaderboards but tied to the Workshop map. This process will be similar to the staff-approved unit payouts that both Minigolf and Ball Race will require. The staff-approved process will be done by us tagging a Workshop map as “Unit Approved” and then the unit payouts & leaderboards will be enabled for that map. This is planned so we can ensure maps are made fairly and not just for unit boosting.

Workshop Sound Packs
We’re really excited to share we’ve been working on Workshop Sound Packs. These will allow players to upload custom sound packs to the Workshop to use in their Condos and SDK Maps! This feature should be available in the next update.

Workshop Rig
We’re also very close to finishing a guide for the new Workshop rig and putting some finishing touches on implementing it in the game, and that will be coming out very soon as well.

Transit Station Optimization/Art Pass
We also wanted to share that we’ve been doing optimization work as well as an art pass on the Transit station, which will improve performance and visuals.

Arcade, SDNL, and Game World Maps
We’ve gotten started on implementing voice lines for SDNL, but, since working on the Boardwalk, we’ve also been talking about shifting gears and getting some work done on the Arcade as we discussed at the beginning of the year. These discussions have been about finishing games that have artwork, adding new games, and doing optimization work.

There has already been progress on that optimization work, mainly reducing server-side CPU calculations to help with server performance.

Game World Maps are still always in development and waiting for an opportunity for testing and release, and we’re experimenting with some fun ideas for upcoming ones that we’re excited to see come to fruition.

Backend Work / Organization
There’s a couple of things we wanted to touch base on in regard to backend work.

In previous Dev Updates, we brought up the Patron rewards as well as Dedicated Condos work. Patron rewards have had some delays as we were prioritizing a new ban appeal system that will better streamline our moderation process, and dedicated Condos have had delays due to Plaza Optimization work mentioned above. You should see progress on both soon.

We’ve also been working on more thoroughly going through and organizing our forum backlog of bug reports, crashes and other game issues, as well as suggestions. We may ask for some feedback from you all to help us out with narrowing down existing issues in a survey some time, so keep an eye out for that.

That’s gonna do it for this Dev Update, thanks for reading!

notes.title: Tower Unite Anniversary Events! (0.17.10.0)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/46a0bc099295d31e57d1797e4d3e5af31ee8f8b1.png
To celebrate Tower Unite's debut to Early Access, we're starting our Anniversary Event celebrations!

Kalleira, wanting to celebrate with everyone, caused mayhem by bringing in all the characters and minigames from all the holiday events. Due to her magic, this event features minigames from Halloween events and Winter Holiday events all at the same time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/9da5e2799d67c7df741036d9d2f8a5d20b394254.png

You can also earn Anniversary Coins from playing any of the game worlds or minigames in Tower and unlock anniversary themed items, Halloween items, and Winter Holiday items!

This event will last for the entire month of April, so you'll be able to take your time getting coins!


New Anniversary Items!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/96da4f6ab7855ace87d57226f9e8fc3945998ef5.png
Head to Kalleira near the Plaza fountain!
We plan to have more anniversary items in a future update.

Two Way Block
This update comes with a new feature that should help reduce harassment in-game. Two-Way Block is a new standard for the block feature. If you block a player, the other player will automatically have you blocked as well and can no longer see/hear your chat. The player you have blocked cannot remove this block.

Co-Op Condo / Mover Fixes
There's been a lot of desync issues with co-op condos that are now resolved in this update. Before, editing items would sometimes not upload their edited values as a client to the condo host, including groups not syncing. This has all been resolved in this update. Grouping and ungrouping items will now sync properly between client and hosts, and item properties are sent properly as well.

Movers also had a known issue where restoring from save data would not always work, which is now fixed in this update.

New Condo IO Features
More condo IO items were added in this update:
 Mover Controllable: A mover that is designed to be controlled by user input/buttons
 Player Input Volume: A usable volume that listens to player inputs and fires outputs based on it. Has support for Forwards, Backwards, Strafe Right, Strafe Left, Jump, Run, Weapons 1-8, Flashlight, Reload, Inventory, and Context key binds
 Global Message Module: A module that announces messages in chat or on the HUD, wish whisper support. Supports %name% keyword, which will display the player name.
Cornelius and Birb Plush
Don't miss out! The Cornelius and Birb Plush Campaign on Makeship has started!
You can now order a Cornelius and Birb Plush to fund the campaign! Limited time only! 

https://www.makeship.com/products/cornelius-plush

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/43aaf9232925e93c4509c0561968599a44f98445.jpg




Changes
 Start of Anniversary 2024 events!
 Added new Anniversary items!
 Added Two Way Block System. If you have blocked a player, the other player will also have you blocked automatically. Players you have blocked will not be able to see your join/leave messages as well.
 Added Keycard, Keycard Receptacle to Central Circuit store
 Added Metal Rung Ladder, Concrete Lattice, Glass Blocks to DIY store
 Added Basic Planks, Plastic Barrel, Plastic Barrel (Physics) to Rob's Imports store
 Plaza: Added token and ticket machines next to Balloon Pop
 Condo: Added No Collider tool to Tool Glove
 Condo - Build UI: Added Group / Ungroup buttons
 Condo: Show Volumes setting now disables inventory grab/traces and box selection of Volumes when Volumes are hidden
 Condo: Easter Basket item can have its handle hidden now
 Condo: Added "Display Glow" setting to Pile of Units, Always Lucky Slot Machine, and Treasure Chest of Units items
 Condo/SDK: Ball Race Orb milestone now matches the same speed & mass as the Ball Race orb in Ball Race
Optimizations
 Plaza: Surf Shop optimization pass
 Plaza: Optimization of Boardwalk's support structure
 Condo: Optimized all Base Physics items (including Physical Media), they now properly handle resting states and don't overcalculate when frozen or in rest state
 Condo: Optimized Water Volume, resolving performance issues when a water volume is placed in a condo with many items
 Condo: Optimized all light items by reducing FadeToColor calculations
 Condo: Optimized Pile of Units, Always Lucky Slot Machine, and Treasure Chest of Units items
Condo IO Changes
 Condo IO: Added additional SDNL gametypes to Game World Events module
 Condo IO: Added new Mover - Mover Controllable, a mover that is designed to be controlled by user input/buttons
 Condo IO: Added Player Input Volume, a volume that listens to player inputs and fires outputs based on it, once a player uses it. Has support for Forwards, Backwards, Strafe Right, Strafe Left, Jump, Run, Weapons 1-8, Flashlight, Reload, Inventory, and Context key binds
 Condo IO: Added Global Message module, which will announce messages in chat or on the HUD, with whisper support
 Condo IO: Added "GotoFromHere" to Mover Simple, which will travel the mover to a position relative to where it currently is
 Condo IO: Added "SetRotation" and "AddRotation" to Mover Simple, Mover Path
 Condo IO: Added "Display Stand", "Display Glow", and "Pickup Effects" settings to Weapon Pickup
 Condo IO: Added "SetType" input to Weapon Pickup
 Condo IO: Added "OnSpawned", "OnRespawned" outputs to Weapon Pickup
 Condo IO: Added "MultiplySize" and "AddSize" inputs to Size Volume
 Condo IO: Added "Modulo" input to Counter
 Condo IO: Added "Copy" input to counter, which will copy another counter's value to the counter
 Condo IO: Fixed Switches & Levers not calling their on/off IO outputs when first loaded
 Condo IO - Movers: Added "Auto Start Spin" option
 Condo IO: Added "SetPitch" and "SetVolume" input to Sound Emitters
Bug Fixes
 Fixed Workshop browser sometimes getting stuck loading forever
 Condo - Coop Condo: Fixed major desyncs where clients would set item properties and the server/host would not receive all the item property changes as it would skip certain properties. This fixes long standing sync issues with co-op condos
 Condo - Coop Condo: Fixed editing items not saving to server if you edit a different item without closing the item you are editing first
 Condo - Coop Condo: Fixed item connections not applying when switching to IO debugger tab
 Condo - Coop Condo: Fixed connection tool not setting selected input/outputs properly when connecting an item as a client
 Condo - Coop Condo: Fixed Grouping not networking to the server/host if a client creates a group of items
 Condo IO - Movers: Fixed movers not always restoring from save data properly
 Condo/SDK: Fixed Gizmo trace distance not matching the new long trace distance
 Condo: Fixed No Collide property not copying with Copy Cat or shift drag copy
 Condo: Fixed Item Finder search bar inputting Q over and over when first clicked on it
 Condo - Build UI: Fixed grouping items not updating the group info panel
 Condo: Fixed a crash relating to Nightclub Media players and IO events
 Condo: Fixed FadeToColor IO event not coloring emissive materials of lights

 Condo: Fixed Floating Text items being slightly off for clients
 Condo: Fixed Blocking Volume still blocking physics items even with ignore physics setting disabled
 Condo: Fixed sound emitters starting by default for clients even if they are set to not start by default
 Condo: Fixed all seat items not all having IO inputs that all seats should have (Eject, OnEnter, OnLeave)
